Adamantine Archdragon.name: Adamantine Archdragon
Adamantine Archdragon.publicNotes:
The powerful adamantine dragons are one of several dragons known as skymetal dragons. The innate magic that flows through these dragons causes them to draw particular metals to their bodies like magnets or, in some cases, naturally grow these skymetals on their bodies. Adamantine dragons begin their lives with tough scales that are naturally replaced with thicker and even tougher adamantine plating as they grow older. Adamantine dragons are typically steadfast and loyal. Once they commit to a certain purpose, changing their minds is nigh impossible.

Dragons come in myriad forms, with many having magical abilities or connections to magic. Some dragons draw greater power from magic than others, allowing them to manifest abilities or alter their physiques with prolonged exposure to magic. Estos dragons become more powerful as they age and strengthen their connections with their magical origins. Scholars debate the classification of these dragons, with some preferring the name magical dragons and others using traditional dragons due to their connection to specific magical traditions. Regardless of their names, these dragons share a number of characteristics: their ability to tap into magical energies, intensified might and cunning as they grow older, and an inclination to hoard vast amounts of treasure and wealth.

Ainamuuren.name: Ainamuuren
Ainamuuren.publicNotes: Like all saumen kar, Ainamuuren is a large, muscular humanoid with large horns atop his head. Thick, white fur covers everywhere except his face, hands, and pies, which reveal darker skin beneath the fur, covered in an intricate pattern of stylized runes. Unlike other saumen kar, Ainamuuren possess not two but four long, curving horns, jutting from his head like a primal crown. The large, magical greataxe he carries bears intricate, stylized runic patterns that greatly resemble those carved upon his flesh, with the same sharp focus on angular lines and triangular shapes.
Ainamuuren.saveDetails: +1 bonificador de estado to saves against evil and necromancy conjuros and effects

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.8COlYvHe6hKCXY8x]

Esta gran hacha de batalla es demasiado pesada para empuñarla con una sola mano. Many greataxes incorporate two blades, and they are often "bearded", having a hook at the bottom to increase the strength of their chopping power.

action->Blizzard Evasion.name: Evasion de ventisca
action->Blizzard Evasion.description:
Desencadenante Ainamuuren takes at least 40 points of daño físico from a single attack, and he isn't currently discorporated

Efecto Ainamuuren discorporates into a whirling blizzard for 3 asaltos. During this time, he gains resistance 10 to daño físico and weakness 10 to daño de fuerza. He gains a fly speed of 40 pies, but the only action he can take is to Fly. While discorporated, the first time each round that Ainamuuren enters another criatura's space or a criatura enters Ainamuuren's space, that criatura takes @Damage[4d8[cold]] daño and must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. At the start of his turn, Ainamuuren can end this effect as a free action.

action->Frostbite Runes.name: Runas de congelación
action->Frostbite Runes.description: Ainamuuren is marked by the runes of the saumen kar, a gift tied to their ancient curse. Ainamuuren gains a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación against evil and necromancy conjuros and effects. He can sense the presence of evil undead as a pervasive taste of oily corruption in the air. Este is a vague sense that allows him to know when such a criatura is within 60 pies, though he can't precisely pinpoint their location with this sense. Este sense also extends to living criaturas who have the curación de vacío ability, like dhampir.

action->Snowblind.name: Snowblind
action->Snowblind.description: Ainamuuren puede @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} y @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} during even light snowfall, even si ello wouldn't be thick enough a normally grant ocultacion.

action->Curse of the Saumen Kar.name: Maldición del Saumen Kar
action->Curse of the Saumen Kar.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Ainamuuren activates the runes covering his body to create an icy prison around a Huge or smaller criatura he can see within 60 pies. The prison is a sphere made of unmelting ice, just large enough to fit his target. El objetivo, and any criaturas sharing its space, must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:34] salvación. A criatura that fails becomes trapped inside the prison. If it succeeds, the criatura is pushed outside the prison into a space of its choice. If el objetivo shares its space with a gargantuan criatura, the effect fails.

The dome has AC 10, Hardness 20, and 40 Puntos de Golpe; and is immune to cold, critical hits, and daño de precisión. The prison lasts until destroyed, until Ainamuuren uses this ability to create a new prison, or until he dies.

Anadi Elder.name: anadi anciano
Anadi Elder.publicNotes:
Anadi elders must make the difficult decision of whether to continue negotiations or to escalate a disagreement to outright conflict.

Anadis are peaceful, reclusive humanoids who live deep within woodlands, jungles, and other untamed areas of wilderness. Their natural forms resemble humanoid spiders covered in beautiful and distinctive markings of varying colors. Estos patterns are as unique as other humanoids' facial features, birthmarks, and other identifying aspects.

Anadis possess an innate talent for illusion and transmutation. They learned long ago how off-putting their natural forms can be to other humanoids, so they frequently use their innate talents to assume human forms. When they do so, only a strange, lovely sheen to their dark eyes and the deliberative, jerky movements of their gestures might indicate that an anadi is not entirely what they appear. As they are well aware of and accommodating toward other humanoids' delicate sensibilities about arachnids, many anadis consider it rude to show their natural forms to a stranger. Instead, most display their spider-like forms only as an INTIMIDATION tactic when threatened, or in privacy to those they trust.

Most anadi tend to be shy and seek to live quiet lives harvesting mushrooms and weaving beautiful, patterned silk cloth. When forced into combat-an eventuality most anadis despise-they shift into their hybrid forms as soon as possible, allowing them to inflict their devastating natural venom on their foes.

Animated Bamboo Figurine.name: Animated Bamboo Figurine
Animated Bamboo Figurine.publicNotes: Supple but strong bamboo strips woven into intricate patterns form the base of the animated bamboo figure. Estos materials are plentiful and easy to come by, though they require great care and patience to prepare, making them ideal guardians for isolated communities. Estos hollow and pliable handcrafts can stretch or compress, jumping and springing farther than most humanoids.

action->Construct Armor (Hardness 3).name: Construct Armor (Hardness 3)
action->Construct Armor (Hardness 3).description: Like normal objects, an animated bamboo figuring has Hardness. Este Hardness reduces any daño it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated bamboo figuring is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, or immediately upon being damaged by a impacto crítico, its armadura de constructo breaks and its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to 16.

action->Spring Forward.name: Spring Forward
action->Spring Forward.description: The animated bamboo figure jumps up to 30 pies and makes two fist Golpes against different targets. It can use Knockdown following this activity, attempting to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} each criatura struck.

Animated Kite.name: Animated Kite
Animated Kite.publicNotes: Un animated kite es perfect for spying, allowing observation de un great distance, although many son treated more like pets. El kite itself es un simple handcraft, easily created y destruido, made de enchanted paper stretched over un fine bamboo frame. More advanced kites puede be decorated con un variety de runas que allow el enchanter a see o hear de un distance.

action->Construct Armor (Hardness 1).name: Construct Armor (Hardness 1)
action->Construct Armor (Hardness 1).description: Like normal objects, an animated kite has Hardness. Este Hardness reduces any daño it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated kite is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, or immediately upon being damaged by a impacto crítico, its armadura de constructo breaks and its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to 13.

action->Attach Line.name: Attach Line
action->Attach Line.description: The animated kite gives its line to an adjacent ally with a free hand. The kite remains attached until the criatura releases it or the kite flies more than 60 pies away. A criatura between them can also sever the line with a successful Golpe against AC 13 that deals any amount of daño cortante.

action->Sawing Line.name: Sawing Line

Animated Wine Vessel.publicNotes: Un beautiful wine vessel presents un mark de status among drinkers, a say nothing de un animated one que pours el wine en su own. Although normally harmless servants, these vessels va a just as quickly follow instructions a swallow intruders y drown them en strong wine.

action->Construct Armor (Hardness 4).name: Construct Armor (Hardness 4)
action->Construct Armor (Hardness 4).description: Like normal objects, an animated wine vessel has Hardness. Este Hardness reduces any daño it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once an animated wine vessel is reduced to less than half its Puntos de Golpe, or immediately upon being damaged by a impacto crítico, its armadura de constructo breaks and its ARMOR CLASS is reduced to 17.

action->Spit Wine.name: Spit Wine
action->Spit Wine.description: The wine vessel opens its mouth and blows a stream of wine in a @Template[line|distance:15], dealing @Damage[2d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

action->Wine-Soaked.description: When a criatura ends its turn Swallowed Whole by the animated wine vessel, it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:19] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Aoyin.name: Aoyin
Aoyin.publicNotes: An aoyin resembles an ox with a pale body, four horns, and hair as coarse as straw. Although this large, solitary beast bears a slight resemblance to the common draft ox, it's a highly aggressive and territorial carnivore who stalks and devours its prey. An aoyin dwells high in the mountains, rarely being seen by common folk. However, during lean winters, an aoyin might descend from its mountain home in search of food, resulting in gruesome encounters with nearby settlements. It's believed that a single aoyin can decimate the population of an entire village, only to retreat into the nearby mountains once it has satiated its hunger. An aoyin, even a herd of the criaturas, is primarily driven by hunger and other natural urges. Outside of its natural habitat, an aoyin might occasionally be kept by those who revel in bloodlust. Even with magical control, a captive aoyin is more likely to turn on its handlers than obey commands. As an uncontrolled arma, however, a hungry aoyin poses a terrible threat to most communities. Tales in certain isolated areas claim that the growling call of an aoyin can drive those unlucky enough to hear it into a frenzy of hunger and violence. Villages will be found consumed by infighting without any sign of an aoyin even entering its borders. Although it's possible a powerful variant of this criatura might possess this ability, most of these stories are inspired by the terrible magic available to those who understand the aoyin's secrets and are spread when villages collapse through magic compulsions or mundane infighting.
Aoyin.privateNotes:
Aoyin Horns

The horns of an aoyin are a potent material for CRAFTING magical items that induce a frenzied state or blood loss, much like in tales about the beast's calls. Each horn, of which an aoyin normally has four, can be used as 60 gp worth of materials for items like a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.fo6Yhq5mbQXsnZs0]{Wounding rune}.

If a criatura within 40 pies is taking daño persistente de sangrado, the aoyin can also Zancada up to its Velocidad in a straight line toward that target as it seeks out the closest source of food.

action->Horn Toss.name: Horn Toss
action->Horn Toss.description: The aoyin Strides and makes a horn Golpe. If the Golpe hits, el objetivo is flung 20 pies in a direction of the aoyin's choice.

action->Mountain Stride.name: Mountain Zancada
action->Mountain Stride.description: Un aoyin isn't impeded by terreno dificil causado por nieve o mountainous terrain, nor does ello need a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} a mover over uneven suelo creado por those conditions.

Asanbosam.name: Asanbosam
Asanbosam.publicNotes:
Asanbosams are monstrous, hairy humanoids with cold iron fangs and muscular limbs that end in powerful, hooked claws. They hang in treetops from their hooked pies, waiting patiently for a criatura to pass by below. Asanbosams GRAB their prey from above, latching onto their unfortunate victims' necks to drain their blood. They react to perceived intrusions with belligerence, stalking visitors from high branches. Locals tell horror stories of these "bloodsucking tree-folk," and experienced explorers keep a close watch on the treetops in asanbosam territory. Visitors to the Expanse often compare asanbosams to vampires, but these horrors aren't undead and bear no relation.

An asanbosam's diet calls for a large amount of iron (typically in the form of blood) to maintain the integrity of its oversized cold iron teeth. When not hunting or mating, an asanbosam spends its waking hours chewing on certain types of rocks to sharpen its teeth.

Some folk tales claim that asanbosams are as old as time and the original source of cold iron, and that veins of the metal found in the ground are truly the graveyards of ancient asanbosams. Brave (or foolish) poachers often infiltrate asanbosam territory to hunt these monsters in the hope of collecting sacks of their valuable teeth.

action->Attack from Above.name: Attack from Above
action->Attack from Above.description:
Requisitos The asanbosam is positioned above a criatura

Efecto The asanbosam makes a claw Golpe with its reach increased to 15 pies. On a hit, the Golpe deals an additional @Damage[1d6[slashing]] daño and the asanbosam immediately Grabs el objetivo and pulls it to a space adjacent to the asanbosam.

Este counts as two attacks for the asanbosam's multiple attack penalización.

action->Drink Blood.name: Beber sangre
action->Drink Blood.description:
Requisitos A @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or willing criatura is within reach of the asanbosam's jaws

Efecto The asanbosam sinks its teeth into the criatura to drink its blood. If the victim is grabbed, this is automatic; otherwise, the asanbosam must succeed at an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the victim's Fortitude DC. The victim becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the asanbosam regains @Damage[10[healing]] HP, gaining any excess Puntos de Golpe beyond its maximum as Puntos de Golpe temporales. Estos Puntos de Golpe temporales remain for 1 minuto.

Drinking Blood from a criatura that's already drained increases the victim's drained value by 1 to a maximum of drained 3, but doesn't restore any HP to the asanbosam.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 each week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful @Check[medicine|dc:20|name:Drink Blood Treatment] check and a blood donor or sufficient blood, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutos.

Aso Berang.name: Aso Berang
Aso Berang.publicNotes: Deep within the woods are grand, giant criaturas with tusked maws. Their visages have inspired various tusked demon masks used for great festivals across Tian Xia. Estos beasts are known as aso berangs, or bear dogs, in the islands of Minata. As their name suggests, they resemble large canines with the bulk of a bear. However, aso berangs aren't simply large and charismatic animals, for many say they're the kings of forest spirits and patrons of guardians. They're often revered as protective entities by those who live outside the woods they guard. Estos guardians only appear to common folk if the forest they live in is in danger or if they need something. When they do so, aso berangs can appear as large and powerful humans who emanate a regal presence. Aso berangs have wickedly sharp talons that shed regularly, and they're strong enough to CLIMB trees in pursuit of witches who attempt to escape up them. Very often, aso berangs attack visitors whose hearts they deem impure or those they consider as potential threats to their forest. Unfortunately, receiving this judgment usually takes little more than forgetting to perform the proper rites of respect and reverence.
Aso Berang.privateNotes:
Enmity de Witches

El first aso berang y ancestor de todos aso berangs, Ganas Buti Rajah, faced el witch armies de Rani Randa, el Queen de Witches y Tanggal. Now, Ganas Buti Rajah's descendants uphold el tradition de stewardship: protecting el bosques y cleansing el lands de magia ellos judge evil.

Once they fail a Golpe (or upon succeeding at their third Golpe), the aso berang Strides back to the space where they began.

action->Phantom Flames.name: Phantom Flames
action->Phantom Flames.description: The aso berang's flames are as much spectral as physical. Siempre que an aso berang deals daño de fuego, they can have that daño be daño de espíritu instead. The aso berang's flames never burn plants or objects unless the aso berang wishes it.

Augdunar.name: Augdunar
Augdunar.publicNotes:
Selectively bred over the course of centuries to be as strong, tough, and grouchy as the dwarves of Highhelm themselves, augdunars are a unique breed of mule favored by the merchants of the Sky Citadel for transporting goods and assisting with manual labor. Unlike mules found elsewhere on Golarion, augdunars are capable of producing offspring—though significantly fewer than ordinary equines. Este has led to a steady, but controlled, stock of the criaturas, allowing for the population to be selfsustaining. Augdunars are smaller than typical mules to accommodate dwarven height, measuring about four and a half pies tall and weighing between 400 and 600 pounds.

Because of their ability to carry loads beyond that of the traditional mule, in addition to the ability to breed amongst themselves, augdunars are a frequent target of thieves or opportunistic merchants. No Highhelm citizen worth their stone willingly sells an augdunar to outsiders, so attempted thefts on the road are common. Unfortunately for these robbers, the mules are quite loyal to their owners and bray loudly siempre que a stranger handles their leads. Combined with a heavy kick to the skull from the animal, any attempts to make off with an augdunar have low odds of succeeding.

While rare, small groups of the augdunar have broken away from dwarven control over the years and created feral colonies in the Five Kings Mountains. Estos colonies are largely safe from ordinary predators, such as wolves, and graze on mountainside plants. Due to their low birthrate, feral augdunars don't need to have their population controlled, though caravanners do attempt to capture and redomesticate them in an effort to increase profit.

Despite being natural beasts of burden, dwarves don't often use augdunars as mounts. The mules seem to have an instinctive dislike of riders, to which the deep bite marks and hoofprints left in those who try can attest. That's not to say that some haven't succeeded, however. Those who put forth the effort required to create a bond with an augdunar find that their persistence can pay off. Augdunar loyalty is unparalleled and even thieves know to not attempt to steal an augdunar that's carrying a rider.

action->Back Kick.name: Back Kick
action->Back Kick.description: The augdunar whirls around, delivering a powerful kick with both its hind legs. The augdunar makes a hoof Golpe. If the Golpe hits, the augdunar deals an extra 1d10 daño contundente. Este counts as two attacks when calculating the augdunar's multiple attack penalización.

action->Determined Trudge.name: Determined Trudge
action->Determined Trudge.description: The augdunar Strides at a –5 pies penalización de circunstancia to its Velocidad, ignoring difficult terrain.

Aurosrath.name: Aurosrath
Aurosrath.publicNotes:
Greed can be a powerful force; the runelords of old even devised a school of magic based upon it. When an individual dies surrounded by masses of wealth, greed can even reanimate the dead—sufficient avarice can anchor the deceased's soul to their body. The result is an aurosrath, a being so consumed with greed that they're unwilling to donate their corpse to the natural cycle.

Popular LORE surrounding the creation of an aurosrath often depicts a miser ironically crushed under the weight of their own gold. While such poetic origins can happen, the truth is often grimmer. Paranoia about potential thieves and freeloaders leads to isolation, both mental and physical. A wealthy merchant succumbs to common illness because they were unwilling to pay the fee for a doctor or priest. Another starves, unable to escape the web of traps and barriers they've set up to defend their treasure from robbers.

Heralded by the clinking of coins, an aurosrath appears as a bloated cadaver who's clad in faded finery, their bulk nearly bursting at the seams with tarnished coins. Their voices are typically a booming bass, their speech peppered with archaic upper-class turns of phrase. They are single-minded in their desire to accumulate wealth but can be reasoned with so long as they believe that goal will ultimately be satiated. An aurosrath can often be found haunting the estates they owned in life. As they brook no competition when it comes to accumulating wealth, they quickly turn to violence when encountering others of their kind. Estos monstrosities do, however, occasionally command the loyalty of lesser undead and even mercenary mortal servants.

action->Smeltable.name: Smeltable
action->Smeltable.description:
If an aurosrath takes 5 or more daño de fuego from a single attack, the precious metals within their body enter a molten state until the end of their next turn. While in this state, the aurosrath takes a –10-pies penalización de estado to their Velocidades, and their strikes deal an extra @Damage[1d6[fire]] daño. They also lose their weakness to daño cortante and their resistance to daño de electricidad. Finally, any criatura currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the aurosrath loses 1 asalto of air if it's holding its breath.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.PeQ2isu6YFcHhQyp]{Efecto: Smeltable}

action->Fetters of Debt.name: Fetters of Debt
action->Fetters of Debt.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutos

Efecto The aurosrath bellows a plea for gold, remarking that their foes are overladen. Las criaturas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:19] salvación or become encumbered for 1 minuto. The criatura is aware that it can immediately end the condition by giving the aurosrath items or treasure worth at least 20 gp. Handing a held item to the aurosrath is a single INTERACT action. If the aurosrath's hands are full, the item falls in their space, but the condition still ends.

action->Suffocating Wealth.name: Suffocating Wealth
action->Suffocating Wealth.description: As the aurosrath holds their victim, the victim is smothered in a stream of phantom coins. A criatura who begins its turn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by an aurosrath no puede hablar and must hold its breath or it begins to suffocate. The coins produced are ephemeral and melt away to nothing when removed from the aurosrath's presence for more than 1 asalto.

Azarketi Sailor.name: Azarketi Sailor
Azarketi Sailor.publicNotes:
Azarketis, also known as Low Azlanti o gillmen, puede be found todos over Golarion, con un particularly high concentration around Absalom y el Inner Sea. Descendants de el antiguo Azlanti, el azarketis survived el cataclysm de Earthfall by fleeing into el sea, where ellos fueron warped into amphibious forms by el alghollthu, el alien architects de Absalom's terrible demise. Generally found en el coast, azarketis favor life near un superior cuerpo de agua, as keeping su piel hydrated es un biological requirement. Though most azarketis live relatively peaceful lives de fishing o farming, ellos sometimes need a defend su homes against hostile forces, y some leave su communities a quedan adventurers. El following statistics puede be used a represent commonly encountered azarketis.

Azarketis con more adventurous espiritus often learn el art de sailing y join el crew de un ship. Such sailors get a enjoy su time above deck mientras also having near-constant access a grande bodies de agua. Ship captains also appreciate having azarketis en board, as ellos're able a easily scrape barnacles off el hull, prueba el rudder, y help patch cualquier leaks. Though ellos tienen un talent for swimming more than sailing, ellos've earned un reputation as lucky a tienen en board.

action->Hydration.name: Hidratación
action->Hydration.description: Azarketi must regularly submerge themselves in water to rehydrate their water-acclimated skin. After the first 24 horas outside of water, they gain a -1 penalización de estado to Fortitude saves as their skin cracks and their gills become painful. After 48 hours, they struggle to breathe air and begin to suffocate until returned to water.

action->Sea Legs.description: An azarketi sailor gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} and can roll twice and take the better result on checks to Balance while aboard a ship.

action->Submerged Stealth.name: Submerged Stealth
action->Submerged Stealth.description: While submerged in water, an azarketi sailor gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia on their STEALTH check, indicated above.

Efecto The azarketi sailor swings a distance equal to up to twice their Velocidad, moving in a straight line, and makes a single Golpe at any point during the movement.

Baccali Alpaca.publicNotes: Una raza druman de alpaca, la alpaca baccali es apreciada por su lana excepcionalmente suave.

Barrage Archdragon.name: Barrage Archdragon
Barrage Archdragon.publicNotes:
To the uninitiated, spellcasting is an art for those with iron wills, people who reach out and GRAB hold of the fundamental laws of the universe and bend them to their whim. It takes discipline, study, and above all else, it takes control. Fail to control the very building blocks of reality and everything could fall apart.

Those who have even dabbled in the arcane arts know that this is nonsense. Magic is chaos, and channeling arcane forces is less akin to exerting one's will over the world and more like surfing on a bolt of lightning through a world-shaking storm and hoping to steer it without falling off. Spellcasting is barely contained panic, a lance of adrenaline, the constant danger of burning oneself out of existence. And the more powerful someone becomes, the more real this danger is.

action->Ironsense.name: Ironsense
action->Ironsense.description: El dragon puede detectar la presencia de hierro y otros metales ferrosos como sentido preciso al alcance indicado.

At any point during this movement, the dragon can make up to two claw Golpes; each of these Golpes deals an additional @Damage[(3d8+3)[force]] daño.

action->Pushing Pulse.name: Pushing Pulse

Beiran Frosthunt.name: Beiran Frosthunt
Beiran Frosthunt.publicNotes:
With pale-blue skin and white hair, the wicked beiran fey are among the most unrepentantly cruel of the First World's spawn. Commonly called ice fey, these wintry tricksters are sadistic and without remorse in their desire to spread the cold wherever they go. Beirans find freezing temperatures to be the most comfortable; the fact that other criaturas suffer under such conditions is part of the fun. While a single beiran is unlikely to change the temperature of a given space by more than a few degrees, they're highly social criaturas, and it's uncommon to find fewer than a few dozen beirans at any one time.

Though beirans are unapologetic in their rude NATURE, there's one type of criatura they'll bow to and take orders from with no questions asked: winter hags. For reasons unknown, beirans are particularly subservient to these hags and will often flock to one in large numbers. Under a winter hag, the fey will make a bad cold snap worse for a suffering town. Fires will be extinguished, wood ruined, food stolen, all of which suit the mysterious tastes of the winter hag and her preference for joyless landscapes. What the beirans receive from this relationship is uncertain, though some fey academics believe it's possible that the first beirans were created by winter hags, much in the same way that the green men created leshies.

While beirans are most common in northern lands such as Irrisen and the Land of the Linnorm Kings, they also have a surprising presence in the Shining Kingdoms. When Queen Elvanna of Irrisen opened up portals to the Eternal Winter of Irrisen, several of them arrived in the town of Heldren in Taldor, and even today, some still haunt the woods around it. Eighteen years ago in Falcon's Hollow, a particularly nasty batch of beirans were involved in the Carnival of Tears, an icy circus that left many townsfolk dead in its wake before adventurers dismantled it. Winters in Kyonin are often heralded by swarms of fiend-touched beirans flooding in from the Tanglebriar, leaving the Wylderhearts on fey duty for months at a time.

action->Unseasonable Cold.description: Wherever the frosthunt goes, winter follows. The temperature within a quarter mile of a frosthunt drops to mild cold, then to severe cold within 500 pies, and extreme cold within 50 pies.

Bibliodaemon.name: Bibliodaemon
Bibliodaemon.publicNotes:
Bibliodaemons son four-armed, weasellike daemons who personify death by paperwork y incompetent bureaucracy. They're often attracted a places where bureaucrats abuse power o cut corners at el expense de el citizens. By disguising themselves as government officials, el bibliodaemons worsen el problems, forging o losing important documents y escalating el complexity de el bureaucracy. Eventually, superior infractions—such as el imprisonment o execution de un innocent person—begin a tear el community apart. El people descend into paranoia y mistrust de su officials, leading a either un revolt against these local governments o complete apathy due a el lack de power a affect change.

Most bibliodaemons work alone a cause este kind de chaos, but en some instances, these fiends tienen been used strategically. After todos, once un area tiene descended into turmoil, ello's easy for another party a dar un paso en y reciben over. During el civil war en Cheliax, bibliodaemons fueron sometimes summoned a destabilize areas en apresa for power. Mientras none va a admit ello, bibliodaemons tienen been present during el various coups y government changes throughout el Shining Kingdoms.

The bibliodaemon can take on the appearance of any Small or Medium humanoid. Este doesn't change their Velocidad or their attack and daño modifiers with their Golpes, but it might change the tipo de daño their claw Golpes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

action->Death by 1,000 Papercuts.name: Death by 1,000 Papercuts
action->Death by 1,000 Papercuts.description: The bibliodaemon launches a torrent of sharp papers from the sleeves of their robes. All criaturas in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] take @Damage[9d6[slashing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:23|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). Las criaturas that fail their save also take @Damage[2d4[bleed]] daño. The bibliodaemon can't use Death by 1,000 Papercuts again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Death by 1,000 Papercuts]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Inevitable Delays.name: Inevitable Delays
action->Inevitable Delays.description:
Requisitos The bibliodaemon's last action was a successful Golpe that dealt daño

Efecto The bibliodaemon intuits the next actions the criatura they just damaged will take and explains how it doesn't have the proper clearance to perform those actions. The criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:23] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Biloko Veteran.name: Veterano de Biloko
Biloko Veteran.publicNotes:
A biloko who has led a sufficient number of successful hunts garners the respect (and fear) of their companions.

Bilokos are crocodile-snouted fey who stalk the Mwangi Jungle and feast upon the flesh of humanoids. As cunning as they are vicious, bilokos employ deadly traps and guerrilla hunting tactics to capture prey-typically hapless explorers or, occasionally, wayward villagers, many of whom believe bilokos to be cruel ancestral spirits. The most powerful of these criaturas, known as elokos, wield potent transformative magic.

Bilokos have a fondness for bells, and the sound of ringing bells often indicates their presence. In addition to carrying and ringing them while out hunting, bilokos sometimes enchant bells with potent magic, or hang them on strings to serve as alarms for their encampments.

Bilokos look like slender but wiry humanoids with crocodile-like heads, rust-colored skin, and blood-red eyes. They eat only the meat of humanoids, though they can survive for extended periods of time on a single meal thanks to their snakelike ability to consume a Medium humanoid criatura whole. They do this by unhinging their jaws and slowly swallowing the victim from head to pies. Thanks to their acidic saliva and sharp teeth, a biloko can masticate their food into an easy-to-digest pulp, grinding flesh and bone into a compact mush, even while swallowing; thus, they do not flinch while devouring meals two or three times their own size.

A recently-fed biloko can be easily recognized by their sagging, distended belly. However, despite their slow appearance, the fey is no less dangerous then, as they delight in killing and might have hungry comrades hiding nearby, waiting to feed.

action->Inspired Feast.name: Inspired Feast
action->Inspired Feast.description:
If a biloko feasts on a human corpse for 1 minuto or more, they gain a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de ataque and a +2 bonificador de estado to tiradas de daño for 1 hora.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.EM0VP31B8CyjFD15]{Efecto: Inspired Feast}

action->Swipe.name: Barrido
action->Swipe.description:
The veteran makes a melee Golpe and compares the tirada de ataque result to the AC of up to two foes, each of whom must be within their melee reach and adjacent to each other. Roll daño only once and apply it to each criatura hit.

A Swipe counts as two attacks for the veteran's multiple attack penalización.

Bog Archdragon.name: Bog Archdragon
Bog Archdragon.publicNotes:
The bogs of Golarion are timeless places, unyielding against the encroachment of civilization and greedily hoarding the dead of epochs long past within the murky depths of the morass. Thus, it doesn't take a bard to note that a bog dragon represents the most primal embodiment of their namesake. Estos dragons are as calm as the brackish waters, as perfectly patient as any crocodile mistaken for debris, and as ancient as any fear held of the realms they dwell within. To the many cultures they've stalked since the first humanoids dared to build their dwellings near brackish fens, a bog dragon is a terror consigned to the nebulous realm of monster and abomination. Though most have been relegated to the stuff of legends and the mythic nightmares of river valley city-states, bog dragons are still out there, lurking beneath the loam.

Bog dragons haunt the parables of old, their primal characteristics a raw expression of a primeval world that rebukes the tyranny of time's progression. Their bodies are those of a belly-dragging thing, corpulent and richly shielded by a scabrous hide of spurs and spines. Their claws, much like their wings, are feeble things, vestiges of a more graceful draconic concept that only the eldest bog archdragon might attain. Their faces are masks of terror; their lips curl back in a snarl to expose brutish grins of dagger-like fangs, pock-marked by vicious stomach acids that give their latent breath the malodorous turpitude that stings the senses almost unto dizziness. They're every inch a night-going monstrosity, a harrowing horror that would drive terror into any who behold them, the pinnacle of marsh-born predators.
Bog Archdragon.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia primigenia

action->Rise Up.name: Rise Up
action->Rise Up.description:
Desencadenante A criatura walks on top of an ancient bog dragon who is burrowed into the mud or peat below

Requisitos Initiative has not yet been rolled

Efecto The bog dragon automatically notices the criatura and Burrows before rolling initiative.

action->Tail Lash.name: Latigazo de cola
action->Tail Lash.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within reach of the dragon's tail makes a Golpe or attempts a prueba de habilidad as part of an attack action

Efecto The dragon Golpes with their tail at the triggering criatura with a –2 penalización. If the Golpe hits, the criatura takes a –2 penalización de circunstancia to the triggering roll.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.QqC9xymSXSVunDgl]{Efecto: Tail Lash}

action->Bog Rot.name: Bog Rot
action->Bog Rot.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Etapa 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minuto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[3d6[acid]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (1 día)

Etapa 3 @Damage[4d6[acid]] daño, torpe 1, and a –5-pies penalización de estado to Velocidad (1 día)

Etapa 4 @Damage[5d6[acid]] daño, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and a –10-pies penalización de estado to Velocidad (1 día)

Etapa 5 death

action->Draconic Frenzy.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uMFB3uw8WTWL0LZD]

El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Nidorous Breath siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Drag Beneath the Muck.name: Drag Beneath the Muck
action->Drag Beneath the Muck.description:
Requisitos The bog archdragon is in a swamp and doesn't have a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in their jaws

Efecto The dragon Burrows, and if they end their movement directly under a criatura, they make a jaws Golpe against that criatura, who is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} against the attack.

If the Golpe is successful, the dragon makes an ATHLETICS check to grapple el objetivo with their jaws; like GRAB, this check doesn't use or contribute to the archdragon's multiple attack penalización.

The dragon then Burrows again; any criatura they have grabbed or restrained in their jaws moves with them.

action->Nidorous Breath.name: Nidorous Breath
action->Nidorous Breath.description: The dragon belches a boiling spray of fermenting stomach acid that deals @Damage[14d8[acid]|options:area-damage] daño and @Damage[2d6[persistent,acid]] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic] salvación). They can't use Nidorous Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Nidorous Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Slain to Serve.name: Slain to Serve
action->Slain to Serve.description:
A bog dragon can perform a special ritual over the body of a humanoid criatura slain by bog rot to raise it as a humanoid intelligent undead.

Este functions like a 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.c3b6LdLlQDPngNIb]{Create Undead} ritual, except that it takes only 8 hours, the bog dragon doesn't require any secondary casters, and they don't need to pay a cost.

If the bog dragon critically fails the ritual's prueba de habilidad, they get a failure instead.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.uJSseLa57HZYSMUu]

Brastlewark Sapper Squad.name: Brastlewark Sapper Squad
Brastlewark Sapper Squad.publicNotes: Discoveries made in Brastlewark played as substantial a role in the construction of the Aspodean Wall as in the battles now raging in its shadow, as teams of gnomish sappers entrenado in the creation and deployment of powerful explosives developed by alchemists seize the opportunity to put their studies to practical use.

action->Demolition Expertise.name: Demolition Expertise
action->Demolition Expertise.description: Un sapper squad's offensive abilities ignore el first 5 points de Dureza cuando deployed against inanimate objects o structures.

action->Excavation.name: Excavation
action->Excavation.description: While Burrowing, the sapper squad can position its segments into a 20-pies-wide straight line and move at half Velocidad to leave a 20-pies-wide tunnel behind them that can be safely traversed by other criaturas. Unless shored up by a crew of skilled laborers, the tunnel collapses after 10 minutos.

action->Fire in the Hole!.name: Fire in the Hole!
action->Fire in the Hole!.description: The squad bombards a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 pies with satchel charges, dealing @Damage[2d6[fire],1d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage]{2d6 daño de fuego and 1d6 daño contundente} to all criaturas in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] salvación). On a critical failure, a criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 asalto. When the squad is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5].

action->Pick Assault.name: Pick Assault
action->Pick Assault.description:
1 to 3

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The sapper squad strikes with their picks against enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] with a @Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] salvación. The daño depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño

2 @Damage[(2d6+4)[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño

3 @Damage[(2d6+7)[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño

action->Undermine.name: Undermine
action->Undermine.description:

Bul-Gae.name: Bul-Gae
Bul-Gae.publicNotes:
Bul-gaes are manifestations of the eclipsed sun and moon. They look like large canines, though their coloration and features change as they exercise their powers over heat and cold. Depending on whether they've most recently unleashed their lunar or solar powers, bul-gaes resemble either a crimson hound wreathed in flames or a cerulean, frostbitten fox, respectively.

Legends say that the first bul-gae attempted to steal the sun from the sky. As they bit down on the burning sphere, though, the bul-gae was badly burned. Having failed, they then tried to retrieve the moon, but when they touched the moon, the bul-gae froze solid and fell to the ground. The descendants of that bul-gae forever hone their powers of flame and ice so that they might one day succeed where their ancestor failed.

Tales say that bul-gaes serve as faithful companions to the ancient, shadowy maestro of the first bul-gae. Estos stories purport that the shadow maestro can see through the distorted light of all bul-gaes and use the hounds as a means to watch the universe for unknown purposes.
Bul-Gae.privateNotes:
Eclipsed Light

Bul-gaes bring with them the distorted light of an eclipse wherever they go. Este distorted light favors blue hues and skews the spectrum of visible colors, giving the world an eerie, muted ambience.

Charau-ka Acolyte of Angazhan.name: Charau-ka Acólito de Angazhan
Charau-ka Acolyte of Angazhan.publicNotes:
Even with the Gorilla King's fall, many charau-ka still worship the terrible might of the god Angazhan. The strongest of these acolytes guard the steps of the High Throne in Usaro, ensuring that no one without Angazhan's favor or suitable physical prowess can approach the top of the massive stone step pyramid.

Legend tells that charau-ka share ancestry with the demon lord Angazhan, who transformed the dead bodies of humans who waged war against his cult, causing them to rise as the first of the mandrill-like humanoids. Though long unproven, rumors persist that charau-ka priests have perfected a hideous ritual that forces the slain to reincarnate as new charau-ka in honor of this ancient tale. Other stories say that powerful altars devoted to Angazhan contain this power, and that conducting ritual sacrifices before these magical artifacts causes the spirits of the dead to return to life as violent devotees of Angazhan, the maestro of those who revel in savagery and destruction.

The largest charau-ka stronghold in the Mwangi Expanse is the city of Usaro, located on the shores of Lake Ocota. Though the death of their Gorilla King has led to political turmoil, the charau-ka will happily unite to kidnap or murder any outsiders in the area.

Charming Scoundrel.name: Charming Scoundrel
Charming Scoundrel.publicNotes:
Este handsome gnome sports an impressive coiffure and a flashy costume that catches the eye.

While most Firebrands enjoy the attention their exploits bring, the charming scoundrel takes this to extremes, often boasting about their daring exploits and attempting to parlay stories of their notorious deeds into free drinks or lodging. The scoundrel sees little harm in taking credit for any activities attributed to the organization, provided that intervention from local law enforcement seems unlikely. They are likely to take on high-profile jobs for the Firebrands just for the thrill of later recounting the narrow scrapes of their adventure.

The charming scoundrel is as dramatic in combat as outside of it, often darting from opponent to opponent and disorienting foes with flashy swordplay. If a battle is going well, the scoundrel will often shout taunts at slow-footed opponents or encouragement to allies. While prideful and competitive, the scoundrel is a pragmatist at heart and will opt to add a tale of a cunning escape to their repertoire if the odds seem stacked against them.

Wherever oppression or an opportunity for daring adventure can be found, the Firebrands can be found chasing after. PCs might find the Firebrands to be allies in a quest for righteous rebellion or justice against slavery, or they might find these dashing daredevils to be friendly-or not so friendly-rivals for the same treasure. The charming scoundrel presented here could easily be a low level freedom fighter or foil for the PCs, or might serve as crew for the privateer captain. The privateer captain can serve as a transport willing to take the PCs to the most dangerous locations, an intermittent ally that provides a timely rescue when least expected, a competing explorer, or a powerful and deadly enemigo.

action->All Becomes Flame.name: All Becomes Flame
action->All Becomes Flame.description:
The dragon curses a criatura within 60 pies to have its magic replaced with primordial flames. The criatura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:43] salvación. Regardless of the result, el objetivo queda temporarily immune for 1 día.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is cursed for 1 asalto. While cursed, any daño the cursed criatura would deal by any means becomes daño de fuego, regardless of the original tipo de daño. The cursed criatura can temporarily suppress the curse for 1 asalto as an action.

Fallo As success, but the curse's duration is 1 hora.

Fallo crítico As success, but the curse's duration is 1 día.

action->Blazing Wind.name: Blazing Wind
action->Blazing Wind.description:
Requisitos The dragon is able to use their Pyre Breath

Efecto The dragon Flies up to their Velocidad in a straight line. At the end of their movement, a superheated gale blows out ahead of them in a @Template[type:line|distance:200] that's 20 pies wide. Structures and vehicles might collapse or catch fire in the whirling inferno, as earthquake. In addition, any criatura in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:45] salvación. Este ability counts as a use of the dragon's Pyre Breath.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes @Damage[8d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño.

Fallo The criatura takes @Damage[16d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño and is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Fallo crítico As failure, plus metal items are superheated and wooden items catch fire. The object takes @Damage[5d6[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] daño, as does the criatura wearing or holding it, though they can drop or take off the item to avoid taking the daño.

action->Pyre Breath.name: Pyre Breath
action->Pyre Breath.description: The dragon breathes a blast of flame that deals @Damage[22d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:70] (@Check[reflex|dc:45|basic] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail their save catch fire, taking @Damage[2d6[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] daño. The area then fills with black smoke for 1 minuto. Este has the effects of mist, except it fills the cone's area. The dragon can't use Pyre Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Pyre Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Stoke the Flames.name: Stoke the Flames

Cinder Archdragon (Spellcaster).name: Cinder Archdragon (Spellcaster)
Cinder Archdragon (Spellcaster).publicNotes: Among the largest and fiercest dragons, cinder dragons are typically volatile, demanding respect—even deference—from lesser criaturas. Cinder dragons' appearance evokes their flame, often in scales with mixed patterns of red, orange, and yellow. Many cinder dragons dwell in active volcanoes and similarly fiery locales. Cinder dragons prefer treasures that can withstand the heat of their bodies and lairs, with gemstones, gold, and silver common among their hoards.

action->Smoke Vision.name: Smoke Vision
action->Smoke Vision.description: Smoke doesn't impair a cinder dragon's vision; they ignore the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} condition from smoke.

Clockwork Cannoneer.name: Clockwork Cannoneer
Clockwork Cannoneer.publicNotes:
Clockwork cannoneers are cannon-armed constructs created to defend the Grand Duchy of Alkenstar. The people of Alkenstar typically find conventional arms sufficient for battling criaturas who wander out of the Mana Wastes, but recent increases in activity from the fleshforges of Nex and the necromantic chambers of Geb have spurred the people of the city into a flurry of defensive innovations. Created by an experimental collaboration between the city's gunsmiths and clockwork inventors, the clockwork cannoneer provides exceptional mobile firepower. Two cannon-arms swing at the sides of the 15-pies-tall automaton, and its body contains a hopper of cannonballs that are replenished by engineers when the criatura is wound up for duty. Triple-walled reinforcement on the cannoneer's black-powder reservoirs provides ample protection from the accidental explosions and backfires that often troubled early prototypes of the finely engineered machine. The current design combines the long-range capabilities of field artillery with the stopping power of a firedrake against engaged enemies, and its heat-tempered gear assembly minimizes warping that might cause slipping, grinding, or shaking.

While reports from living artillery members serving alongside clockwork cannoneers complain of blisters, smoke inhalation, and singed eyebrows, the Grand Duchy's chief clockwork machinists have assured the city's leadership that the constructs function well within safety parameters. The clockwork cannoneer's self-sufficient construction frees crews to see to those battlefield tasks that can, for the moment, only be conducted by sentient beings.

INTELLIGENCE reports from Quantium and Absalom indicate that attempts to replicate the clockwork cannoneer's design have been spectacularly unsuccessful.

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.xS8ybzuqPSi3Jb8k]

action->Wind-Up.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.xS8ybzuqPSi3Jb8k]

24 horas, @Check[thievery|dc:33|traits:action:disable-a-device] check, standby

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another criatura. Este takes 1 minuto. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 horas, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalización to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a criatura, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A criatura can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hora of operational time. Este can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

action->Muzzleburn.description: The heat from a discharged cannon sears those who touch its metal shell. The clockwork cannoneer's bore Golpe deal an additional 2d6 daño de fuego until the end of its next turn after it makes a cannonball Golpe or uses its Bombard or Powder Blast abilities.

Those that fail the save also take @Damage[2d6[persistent,fire]] daño.

Collapsing Structure.name: Collapsing Structure
Collapsing Structure.description: Ebeshra roza una estructura, lo que puede hacer que se derrumbe.
Collapsing Structure.disable: @Check[athletics|dc:43|name:Brace Building (Athletics)|traits:complex,environmental,kaiju,hazard] (maestro), @Check[crafting|dc:43|name:Brace Building (Crafting)|traits:complex,environmental,kaiju,hazard] (maestro), or @Check[engineering|dc:43|name:Brace Building (Engineering)|traits:complex,environmental,kaiju,hazard]{Engineering LORE} (maestro) to brace the structure to reduce the risk of collapse until the end of the criatura's next turn. The DC of the prueba plana for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success, or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the prueba plana DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the structure, ending this hazard.
Collapsing Structure.reset: El building queda susceptible a Shake Apart de nuevo [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds} after ello's stabilized.
Collapsing Structure.routine: The GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:9|showDC:owner] to determine if the building partially collapses, increasing the DC as listed above. On a successful check, dust and debris fall within the building and 30 pies around it, providing concealment and dealing @Damage[6d6[bludgeoning]] daño to [[/r 1d4 #Targets]] randomly chosen targets (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic|name:Falling Debris|traits:hazard,complex,environmental,kaiju] salvación; on a critical failure, the criatura is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}). On a critical success, the effect is the same, but the debris deals @Damage[12d6[bludgeoning]] daño to [[/r 2d4 #Targets]] randomly chosen targets instead (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic|name:Falling Debris|traits:hazard,complex,environmental,kaiju] salvación; on a critical failure, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by rubble until freed [[[/act force-open dc=38]], [[/act escape dc=35]]]).
Collapsing Structure.stealth: (maestro) to notice cracks forming in the walls of the structure as Ebeshra approaches

action->Shake Apart.name: Shake Apart
action->Shake Apart.description:
Desencadenante Ebeshra applies any amount of force to the structure

Efecto The building trembles. The floors of the building and the streets within 30 pies of the building become difficult terrain; criaturas on this difficult terrain take a -2 penalización de circunstancia to tiradas de ataque, AC, and pruebas de habilidad. The hazard rolls initiative.

Conspirator Archdragon.name: Conspirator Archdragon
Conspirator Archdragon.publicNotes:
Escondido among the shadows and upper echelons of SOCIETY are the conspirator dragons. Estos dragons are schemers, always looking to manipulate and control others, either for personal gain or simply for the thrill of watching their machinations play out. Conspirator dragons see themselves above others and typically speak with infantilizing tones and words. However, as most conspirator dragons meet others while in disguise, they do their best to maintain their disguise.

Dragons come in myriad forms, with many having magical abilities or connections to magic. Some dragons draw greater power from magic than others, allowing them to manifest abilities or alter their physiques with prolonged exposure to magic. Estos dragons become more powerful as they age and strengthen their connections with their magical origins. Scholars debate the classification of these dragons, with some preferring the name magical dragons and others using traditional dragons due to their connection to specific magical traditions. Regardless of their names, these dragons share a number of characteristics: their ability to tap into magical energies, intensified might and cunning as they grow older, and an inclination to hoard vast amounts of treasure and wealth.

Draconic Spellcasters

Each dragon features a sidebar on spellcasting dragons of that type. To make a dragon spellcaster, remove the dragon's Draconic Frenzy and Draconic Momentum abilities, and give them the conjuros outlined in their sidebar. Puedes swap out any number of these with other conjuros, provided tú keep the same number of conjuros for each rank. Tú might also want to increase the dragon's INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier by 1 or 2 to reflect their mastery of magic.
Conspirator Archdragon.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra ocultismo

action->Retract Body.name: Retract Body
action->Retract Body.description:
Desencadenante The dragon is hit or critically hit by an attack made by a criatura the dragon can see

Efecto The dragon retracts the targeted body part or twists away to avoid the attack, gaining a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Conjure Disguise.name: Conjure Disguise
action->Conjure Disguise.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The dragon conjures a perfect flesh-suit replica of a humanoid they've seen of their size or smaller and compresses themself into it, along with generating appropriate clothing for the humanoid. Este process takes 1 minuto to complete, during which the dragon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}. If the dragon stops or is interrupted in this process, the suit is destroyed. Once the process is complete, the dragon can remain in this disguise indefinitely.

The transformation has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.eQM5hQ1W3d1uen97]{Change Shape}, except that the disguise is not actively magical in NATURE and doesn't register as magical to detect magic and similar effects. The dragon loses Retract Body while transformed.

If the dragon is critically hit while wearing the disguise, the suit is destroyed and immediately explodes. Este has the effects of Detonate Disguise, except that criaturas use the outcome one degree of success better than they rolled on their save.

action->Detonate Disguise.name: Detonate Disguise
action->Detonate Disguise.description:
Requisitos The dragon is wearing their conjured disguise

Efecto The dragon erupts from the disguise, destroying it. The explosive revelation deals @Damage[21d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño to criaturas in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] with a @Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] salvación. A criatura that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 asalto as it becomes covered in scraps from the disguise.

Any criatura sharing a space with the dragon after they erupt is pushed into the nearest empty space.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: Cuando el dragón consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe, recarga Smoke Breath.

action->Rushed Transformation.name: Rushed Transformation
action->Rushed Transformation.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto Using the aid of magic and an exhausting amount of effort, the dragon quickly reshapes their body into the form of a generic humanoid figure. Este has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} except that it lasts only 1 minuto, and the dragon doesn't gain the +4 bonificador de estado to DECEPTION as the transformation makes use of the dragon's body to crudely mimic a humanoid form. The dragon can Dismiss the effect.

Siempre que the effect ends, the dragon leaves behind scraps of magically conjured flesh, which could give away the dragon's presence.

action->Smoke Breath.name: Smoke Breath
action->Smoke Breath.description:
The dragon unleashes a noxious cloud of smoke that deals @Damage[18d6[poison]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:70] (@Check[fortitude|dc:42|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). The smoke remains for 1 minuto. Este has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, except it fills the cone's area.

The dragon can't use Smoke Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Smoke Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Sneak Attack.name: Ataque furtivo
action->Sneak Attack.description: The dragon's Golpes deal an additional 4d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} targets.

Coral Archdragon.name: Coral Archdragon
Coral Archdragon.publicNotes: Coral dragons are the primal guardians of the vast living coral reefs found in oceans across Golarion. Even by draconic standards, coral dragons stand out for their arrogance and vanity, boasting inordinate pride in the vibrant hues of their own coral-encrusted scales and the dazzling splendor of the reefs they protect. Coral dragons like to decorate their reefs, which they view as lairs, with objects of beauty, dotted with the occasional bit of valuables like coins. Those who seek the favor of a coral dragon often find the criatura easily swayed by flattery, particularly when paired with shiny or brightly colored gifts that complement the scintillating beauty of the dragon and their underwater domain.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Prima.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Primal

action->Biomineralize.name: Biomineralize
action->Biomineralize.description:
Desencadenante The dragon is critically hit by a melee arma without reach or an ataque sin armas that deals slashing or daño perforante

Efecto A gout of blood spurts from the dragon's wound and instantaneously calcifies into a jagged branch of sharpened coral. The coral branch impales the triggering criatura, dealing @Damage[10d6[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:44|basic] salvación). The triggering criatura also takes @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] daño on a critical failure. Regardless of the outcome, the coral then crumbles to dust.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Kaleidoscopic Display.name: Kaleidoscopic Display
action->Kaleidoscopic Display.description:
90 pies. The coral formations covering the dragon's body shimmer with vivid colors, overwhelming the senses. Any criatura entering or beginning its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:42] salvación. Regardless of outcome, the criatura is temporarily immune to the dragon's Kaleidoscopic Display for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 asalto.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico The criatura is blinded for 1 asalto and dazzled for 1 minuto.

action->Reef Bond.name: Reef Bond
action->Reef Bond.description:
Every coral dragon is mystically bound to a single living coral reef. If the dragon moves more than 3 miles from their reef, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and unable to recover, with the sickened value increasing by 1 every 6 hours unless they succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:46] salvación. After 24 horas, the dragon becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}; their drained value increases by 1 every 24 horas.

If the dragon's reef suffers significant daño físico, they immediately become aware of the location where the reef was harmed, but not the source or NATURE of the daño. Should the reef ever be completely destroyed, the dragon is immediately slain.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Hydraulic Breath siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Hydraulic Breath.name: Hydraulic Breath
action->Hydraulic Breath.description: The dragon exhales a pressurized jet of water that deals @Damage[22d6[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño in an @Template[type:line|distance:140] (@Check[reflex|dc:44|basic] salvación). Las criaturas that critically fail their Reflex save against the Hydraulic Breath are pushed back 10 pies and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The dragon can't use Hydraulic Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Hydraulic Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Reef Armor.name: Reef Armor
action->Reef Armor.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The dragon encases themself in an shell of protective coral, gaining 80 Puntos de Golpe temporales and resistance 15 to piercing and daño cortante until the Puntos de Golpe temporales are depleted. The effect lasts for 1 minuto, until destroyed, or until the dragon Dismisses the effect.

action->Reef Meld.name: Reef Meld
action->Reef Meld.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Requisitos The coral dragon is in physical contact with their bound reef

Efecto The dragon physically merges with the reef and vanishes, along with up to 12 willing criaturas, into an extradimensional space where it can neither affect nor be affected by the outside world. The effect lasts indefinitely or until the dragon Dismisses it. Once merged, the dragon can spend 1 minuto traveling to and emerging from any point on its reef up to 10 mile away.

Corbayrant.name: Corbayrant
Corbayrant.publicNotes:
Corbayrants are creations of the Green Mother, one of the fey called the Eldest. In the Age of Creation, she fashioned them from thorns and moss into deadly predators. When gnomes migrated to the mortal Universe, many corbayrants followed but found themselves poorly suited to life outside the First World.

Corbayrants are historically solitary, territorial criaturas. They're incapable of reproducing, and without the revivifying properties of the First World, their numbers are doomed to deplete. Recently, a number of corbayrants in the Verduran Forest have overcome their natures to band together. They've been known to take their prey alive, sacrificing their victims in vile experiments in an effort to find a way to propagate corbayrant numbers.

Corbayrants look like massive clawless scorpions covered in bark and thorns. A rotting fog wafts from their bodies. In the rare instance when they deign to speak, they do so in a raspy whisper.

action->Vitriolic Miasma.name: Vitriolic Miasma
action->Vitriolic Miasma.description:
30 pies.

Non-corbayrants take a –2 penalización de circunstancia to saves against poison effects and gain weakness 10 to daño de veneno while within the aura.

action->Reactive Strike.name: Reactive Golpe
action->Reactive Strike.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within tu reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Tú lash out at a foe that leaves an opening. Make a melee Golpe against the triggering criatura. If tu attack is a impacto crítico and the trigger was a manipulate action, tú disrupt that action. Este Golpe doesn't count toward tu multiple attack penalización, and tu multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this Golpe.

action->Thorny Hide.name: Thorny Hide
action->Thorny Hide.description: A corbayrant's body is covered in jagged spines. Adjacent criaturas that hit them with a melee attack, as well as criaturas that touch them or hit them with an ataque sin armas, take @Damage[4d6[piercing]] daño and are exposed to thorn paralysis.

action->Corbayrant Venom.name: Corbayrant Venom
action->Corbayrant Venom.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:37]

Duración máxima 6 asaltos

Etapa 1 @Damage[8d6[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

Etapa 2 @Damage[9d6[poison]] daño (1 asalto)

Etapa 3 @Damage[9d6[poison]] daño and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 asalto)

action->Spine Volley.name: Spine Volley
action->Spine Volley.description: The corbayrant makes four spine Golpes, each against a different target. Estos attacks all count toward the corbayrant's multiple attack penalización, but the penalización doesn't increase until after the corbayrant makes their attacks.

action->Swallow Whole.name: Engullir
action->Swallow Whole.description:
grande, @Damage[(9d6)[piercing]] plus thorn paralysis, Rupture 30

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

action->Thorn Paralysis.name: Thorn Paralysis
action->Thorn Paralysis.description:
The corbayrant's spines are covered in a paralyzing toxin that cause verdurous thorns to sprout from their victim's body. When a non-corbayrant criatura is exposed, it attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:37] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura sprouts spines like those of the corbayrant. For 1 minuto, the criatura gains the corbayrant's thorny hide ability. Allies attempting to aid the victim with touch-range conjuros and abilities run the risk of becoming infected themselves. At the end of the duration, the spines fall off harmlessly.

Fallo As success, but the criatura is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 minuto. It can attempt another Fortitude save at the end of each turn to end the paralysis, but not the spines.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the criatura doesn't receive a save at the end of its turn to end the paralysis.

Cracked Earth.name: Cracked Earth
Cracked Earth.description: Este 20-pies-by-20-pies patch of ground is cobwebbed with cracks and fissures that crumble when a criatura steps on it.
Cracked Earth.disable: @Check[survival|dc:16] (untrained) to collapse safely; @Check[crafting|dc:20] (entrenado) to shore it up enough to pass over without collapsing it

action->Long Fall.name: Long Fall
action->Long Fall.description:
Desencadenante A criatura steps onto the cracked earth

Efecto The criatura fractures the thin crust of earth and falls through. That criatura can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{GRAB an Edge} reaction to avoid falling, as long as it is adjacent to an edge. Otherwise it takes falling daño (typically @Damage[25[bludgeoning]|options:fall-daño] daño for a 50-pies drop). Some of these rifts eventually lead to the Darklands.

Crystal Archdragon.name: Crystal Archdragon
Crystal Archdragon.publicNotes:
Crystal dragons consider themselves among the more beautiful dragon species and expect others to recognize this. They see little need to accessorize their crystalline hides but might spend hours each day tending to their appearance. They clean themselves frequently, and each scale must be properly faceted and free of imperfections. A crystal dragon may retreat into its lair if its hide gets damaged, manually removing the damaged scales (a painful process!) and then waiting for the replacements to grow in.

Crystal dragons are also proud of their lairs, which typically contain hoards of gems and crystals. An individual dragon's creative NATURE shows through in their decor. So do their organizational skills—they can't tolerate a mess. Their habit of constantly updating and rearranging their spaces means visitors might see a fair bit of disarray, however, depending on their timing.
Crystal Archdragon.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia primigenia

action->+2 Status To All Saves vs. Prima.name: +2 Status To All Saves vs. Primal

action->Cobblegems.name: Cobblegems
action->Cobblegems.description: 10 pies. The dragon constantly sheds crystalline scales onto the ground around it. The area is uneven ground (DC 38).

action->Shielding Stone.name: Shielding Stone
action->Shielding Stone.description:
Desencadenante A criatura at least 10 pies away from the dragon targets them with an attack

Requisitos The dragon is on the ground and there is at least one unoccupied square between themself and the attacker

Efecto The dragon conjures a thin slab of stone in an unoccupied square between themself and the attacker. The dragon gains standard cover against el ataque desencadenante. The stone falls on the first person other than the dragon who enters that square, dealing @Damage[9d6[bludgeoning]] daño with a @Check[reflex|dc:38|basic] salvación. Otherwise, it crumbles harmlessly after 1 asalto.

action->Shimmering Armor.name: Armadura resplandeciente
action->Shimmering Armor.description: When the dragon takes a impacto crítico from any attack that deals daño físico, its hide chips, releasing sharp slivers. All criaturas in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[16d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño with a @Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect] salvación.

action->Crystallize.name: Crystallize
action->Crystallize.description: The claws and tail of a crystal archdragon embed shards that slowly turns the flesh of those they Golpe to crystal. El objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:38|options:inflicts:petrified,inflicts:ralentizado] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure) for 1 minuto. Further failed saves against crystallize increase the ralentizado condition. Once a criatura's actions are reduced to 0 by crystallize, that criatura becomes petrified, turned into crystal instead of stone.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Ornamental Breath siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Lustrous Lunge.name: Lustrous Lunge
action->Lustrous Lunge.description: The dragon strikes a pose that makes its hide sparkle in the light. Each criatura within 20 pies must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:38|inflicts:dazzled] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 asalto.

action->Ornamental Breath.name: Ornamental Breath
action->Ornamental Breath.description: The dragon exhales a torrent of shattered rocks and minerals in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] dealing @Damage[19d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:41|options:area-effect,inflicts:torpe] salvación). A criatura who fails the save is weighed down by the stones, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure).

action->Shard Spray.name: Shard Spray
action->Shard Spray.description:
Frecuencia una vez por minuto

Efecto The crystal archdragon makes 2 tail Golpes, both using its current multiple attack penalización, then spins in a circle, releasing crystalline projectiles. All criaturas within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[9d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). A criatura who critically fails the save is also exposed to crystallize. Este counts as two attacks when calculating the dragon's multiple attack penalización.
