Cuetzmonquali.name: Cuetzmonquali
Cuetzmonquali.publicNotes:
Though stories call it the Burning Dragon, Cuetzmonquali is a unique criatura with no draconic heritage. Cuetzmonquali resembles an enormous reptile with large frills, two tails ending in massive stingers, and scales that appear to be made of burning flame. Cuetzmonquali is capable of growing any number of horns from its head, on which it can impale and trap its enemies. Each horn grows in a burst of searing flame that burns flesh and scales and results in a blackened obsidian spike jutting from its forehead. Estos horns molt off occasionally, leaving behind warnings of the beast's presence.

In combat, Cuetzmonquali is a terrifying foe who uses its horns to skewer foes, unleashes white-hot blasts of flame to devastate those who don't approach, and injects a potent burning venom that ignites a foe from within their own body, sapping their strength. Against groups of weaker foes, it simply tramples them to death underfoot. Anyone courageous enough to face Cuetzmonquali and powerful or cunning enough to slay the criatura can lay claim to the treasure that lies in its belly: the legendario artifact known as the Spear of the Destroyer's Flame.

action->Follower of the Flame.name: Follower of the Flame
action->Follower of the Flame.description: Cuetzmonquali recognizes el might de el wielder de el Spear de el Destroyer's Flame. Out de su respect for que strength, ello follows el commands de el spear's wielder y puede understand el wielder, regardless de el language el wielder speaks.

action->Searing Skin.name: Searing Skin
action->Searing Skin.description: 5 pies. Cuetzmonquali's flesh burns as hot as flame. Las criaturas that end their turn in the emanation take @Damage[4d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:35|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

action->Smoke Vision.name: Smoke Vision
action->Smoke Vision.description: El humo no perjudica la vision de Cuetzmonquali; ignora la ocultacion por humo.

action->Breath Weapon.name: Arma de aliento
action->Breath Weapon.description: Cuetzmonquali unleashes a blast of fire that deals @Damage[12d10[fire]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:50] (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). Las criaturas that fail their saves catch on fire and take @Damage[1d12[persistent,fire]] daño. Cuetzmonquali can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

Cursed King.name: Cursed King
Cursed King.languages: más dos idiomas antiguos cualesquiera (no puede hablar)
Cursed King.publicNotes:
A cursed king is a grotesque mockery of ambition. When treasonous advisors, false prophets, and rebel leaders are captured by evil rulers, they're subjected to all manner of torture and humiliation before their eventual executions. But the cursed king isn't even granted dignity in death, as after their beheading, a desiccated animal head is sewn onto their neck. Estos horrific mummies are then dressed in fine linens and jewelry befitting royalty—a permanent warning of what happens to those who seek to rise above their station.

A cursed king is bound in servitude to the ruler against whom they once fought, forced to act as a bodyguard. Even the death of their maker gives no reprieve, as they guard the true monarch's tomb forever.

action->Deadly Pursuit.name: Deadly Pursuit
action->Deadly Pursuit.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within the cursed king's reach attempts to move away

Efecto The cursed king Strides up to its Velocidad, keeping the criatura within reach until the criatura stops or the cursed king has moved its full Velocidad. If the criatura is still within reach, the cursed king makes a jaws Golpe against it.

action->False Authority.name: False Authority
action->False Authority.description: 30 pies. When a criatura enters or ends its turn within the cursed king's aura, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:26] salvación. If it fails, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}. If it critically fails, it's cowed into submission; in addition to becoming asustado 2, it must use its first action on its turn to kneel or flee from the cursed king. A criatura who succeeds at its tirada de salvación becomes immune to the king's false authority for 24 horas.

action->Usurper's Curse.name: Usurper's Curse
action->Usurper's Curse.description: When a criatura slays a cursed king, it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] salvación. On a failure, it suffers the effects of the usurper's curse.

action->Usurper's Curse.name: Usurper's Curse
action->Usurper's Curse.description: @Check[will|dc:30] tirada de salvación. On a failure, the criatura who killed the cursed king becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}. On a critical failure, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2}. As long as that criatura remains cursed, it can't remove or decrease the value of the stupefied condition in any way. Afflicted criaturas must attempt the tirada de salvación again every 24 horas, increasing the stupefied condition by 1 on a failure or 2 on a critical failure. If the condition ever increases past @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 4}, they transform, body and mind, into the same animal as the cursed king's head, similar to the critical failure effect of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dN8QBNuTiaBHCKUe]{Cursed Metamorphosis}.

action->Berserk.name: Berserk
action->Berserk.description: At the beginning of each of its turns in combat, a cursed king must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:2]. If it succeeds, the DC increases by 1. If it fails, it immediately goes berserk, becoming mindless for the rest of its turn, immune to all mental effects, and attacking the nearest criatura it can reach. While it's berserk, each of its ataques sin armas gain the deadly d8 rasgo. At the end of a turn it failed this prueba plana or siempre que the combat encounter ends, the DC resets to 2.

Delight Archdragon.name: Delight Archdragon
Delight Archdragon.publicNotes:
Some would say delight dragons are like children. They would be correct. At least, as correct as if they said a puff of chimney smoke resembled a massive storm cloud or compared a toddler's drawing of a horse to a prized thoroughbred. Which is to say, they are completely and utterly incorrect. Of course, having a smoke cloud or child's drawing running around one's home might be vastly preferable to a delight dragon.

As residents of the Outer Plane Elysium, delight dragons are embodiments of the plane's proclivity toward joy, mischief, passion, and spontaneity. Their massive gossamer wings refract the light of a thousand rainbows between translucent layers. Purple-green scales shimmer in opalescent splendor, while a long, sinuous tail flicks in spiral figures, darting to catch the pies out from under distracted observers. A pair of feathery antennae direct the delight dragon to their next source of amusement—whether play, treat, or general amusement, all surely to become a great time in the dragon's presence, whether a plane's denizens know it or not.

As self-proclaimed defenders of games, whimsy, and the freedom to sow a little chaos, delight dragons are often found on the front line against those that would strip such choice away from others. Demonic forces deployed at the Worldwound whispered of the "lights of doom," massive rainbows that heralded the approach of a delight dragon. The winged crusader would descend upon these fiends with claws and fangs, cackling all the while.
Delight Archdragon.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra efectos divinos

action->Can't Kill Fun.name: Can't Kill Fun
action->Can't Kill Fun.description: Una vez al día, if the delight archdragon would die, it instead automatically resurrects in its most recently visited lair with half its maximum Puntos de Golpe.

action->Play Scape.name: Play Scape
action->Play Scape.description:
15 pies. Delight dragon magic alters their surroundings, turning armas into toys and conjuros into stage effects. All Golpes and other damaging effects used in the aura gain the nonlethal rasgo and are accompanied by magical sound effects. A criatura entering or beginning their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:45] salvación.

Fallo The criatura's first damaging effect (such as a Golpe) this round does half daño.

Fallo crítico All the criatura's damaging effects this turn do half daño.

action->Reactive Tail.name: Cola reactiva
action->Reactive Tail.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within reach of the dragon's tail uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using

Efecto The dragon attempts an ATHLETICS check to [[/act trip]] the triggering criatura. Este check doesn't count toward the dragon's multiple attack penalización, and its multiple attack penalización doesn't apply to this check.

action->Breath of Fresh Air.name: Breath of Fresh Air
action->Breath of Fresh Air.description: The dragon unleashes a stream of magical bubbles in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60]. Each criatura within the area takes @Damage[16d8[spirit]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[will|dc:45|basic] salvación). A criatura who fails the save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as they give in to the joyful urge to dance, sing, laugh, or admire the world around them. On a critical failure, the criatura is ralentizado 1 for 1 minuto and can't use reactions for as long as they are ralentizado; they can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turn to end the ralentizado condition early.

action->Cloud of Giggles.name: Cloud of Giggles
action->Cloud of Giggles.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The delight dragon transforms into a Huge sparkling cloud of gas for 10 minutos. During this time, the dragon gains resistance 20 to daño físico and is immune to daño de precisión, but they can't cast conjuros, activate items, or use Golpes or actions that have the attack or manipulate rasgo. They can only use their fly Velocidad, can slip through tiny cracks, and occupy the same space as other criaturas. If the dragon ends their turn sharing the same space as other criaturas, each of those criaturas must attempt a @Check[will|dc:45] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} from a fit of giggles until the end of the dragon's next turn. The dragon can Dismiss this action as long as it has space to take its original size.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: Cuando el dragón consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe, recarga Breath of Fresh Air.

action->Let's Play!.name: Let's Play!
action->Let's Play!.description: The dragon conjures up a magical arena to play a game, making up rules on the spot. Any number of target criaturas inside the dragon's aura take @Damage[14d6[mental]] daño from the dragon's baffling explanation (@Check[will|dc:45|basic] salvación). Las criaturas who fail the save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 asalto (1 minuto on a critical failure). Regardless of result, all targets are immune for 24 horas.

Delight Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster).name: Delight Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster)
Delight Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster).publicNotes:
Some would say delight dragons are like children. They would be correct. At least, as correct as if they said a puff of chimney smoke resembled a massive storm cloud or compared a toddler's drawing of a horse to a prized thoroughbred. Which is to say, they are completely and utterly incorrect. Of course, having a smoke cloud or child's drawing running around one's home might be vastly preferable to a delight dragon.

As residents of the Outer Plane Elysium, delight dragons are embodiments of the plane's proclivity toward joy, mischief, passion, and spontaneity. Their massive gossamer wings refract the light of a thousand rainbows between translucent layers. Purple-green scales shimmer in opalescent splendor, while a long, sinuous tail flicks in spiral figures, darting to catch the pies out from under distracted observers. A pair of feathery antennae direct the delight dragon to their next source of amusement—whether play, treat, or general amusement, all surely to become a great time in the dragon's presence, whether a plane's denizens know it or not.

As self-proclaimed defenders of games, whimsy, and the freedom to sow a little chaos, delight dragons are often found on the front line against those that would strip such choice away from others. Demonic forces deployed at the Worldwound whispered of the "lights of doom," massive rainbows that heralded the approach of a delight dragon. The winged crusader would descend upon these fiends with claws and fangs, cackling all the while.
Delight Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster).saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra efectos divinos

Desert's Howl.name: Desert's Howl
Desert's Howl.publicNotes:
Desert's Howl is a towering, gray abomination with a shape vaguely similar to that of a bearded man with glowing yellow eyes, long ibex horns, deadly black claws, and cloven hooves. Estos features have sometimes caused those who encounter it to mistake it for some kind of fiend, a fatal mistake likely to lead to their demise, as Desert's Howl is in truth a twisted aberration composed of a disgusting mix of nightmares, smoke, and ash. As such, holy water and other measures that might be effective against fiends have no effect on Desert's Howl.

According to the oral histories of the people who have survived in the Thuvian desert the longest, when Desert's Howl first appeared, it was in much the same shape but no larger than a human. Over time, its proportions lengthened and grew, as did its frightening abilities and appetite for suffering.

Given the incredible range on Desert's Howl's namesake desolate exclamation, criaturas are much more likely to hear Desert's Howl than see it. Though such forewarning potentially gives distant criaturas additional time to prepare to face or escape the criatura, Desert's Howl enjoys the steady build-up of fear that this approach allows, potentially breaking its victims' resolve long before it even appears. Besides, a criatura of its power has little to fear from travelers, or even most adventurers, regardless of how much time they have to prepare. In the end, a greater struggle just makes destroying them all the sweeter.

action->Aura of Agony.name: Aura of Agony
action->Aura of Agony.description: 10 miles. Desert's Howl exudes a massive psychic disturbance many miles away from its location, assaulting the minds and spirits of those who dare to sleep within the unsettling bounds of its aura of agony. Las criaturas that attempt to rest while they're within this emanation are beset by disturbing nightmares and hallucinations, regardless of whether they're aware of Desert's Howl's presence. Este restlessness causes criaturas to wake up @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, and they don't recover from fatigue by resting. Las criaturas affected by aura of agony don't reduce their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condition by resting as long as they remain within the area of the aura.

action->Fear Scent (Precise) 120 feet.name: Fear Scent (Precise) 120 pies
action->Fear Scent (Precise) 120 feet.description: Desert's Howl can observe any asustado criaturas within 120 pies using an incredibly accurate sense of psychic smell as a precise sense. However, its fear scent extends further if the criatura was asustado by Desert's Howl. The taste of such a bouquet of fear in the air becomes irresistible and easy for Desert's Howl to detect, like a shark smelling blood in water. Desert's Howl can sense a criatura asustado by its own fear effects as an imprecise sense at a distance of up to 1 mile away.

action->Frightful Presence.description:

action->Putrid Evanescence.name: Putrid Evanescence
action->Putrid Evanescence.description:
Frecuencia una vez por minuto

Desencadenante Desert's Howl is damaged by another criatura

Efecto Desert's Howl bursts into a cloud of putrid smoke, ash, and nightmares, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} and teleporting up to 100 pies away to an unoccupied space it can see. It remains invisible until the end of its next turn or until it uses a hostile action, whichever comes first.

action->Forlorn Howl.name: Forlorn Howl
action->Forlorn Howl.description:
Desert's Howl vents a long and desolate wail full of nightmares and despair. The devastating howl can be heard up to 1 mile away under the open sky. Any criatura who hears it experiences a sudden sinking in its stomach and heart palpitations, its hair stands on end, and it must attempt a @Check[will|dc:38] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune for 1 hora.

Éxito The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3}.

Fallo crítico The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 4}, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 asalto.

action->Illusory Ambush.name: Illusory Ambush
action->Illusory Ambush.description: Desert's Howl shimmers with illusions and devastates a foe who lost track of its position. Desert's Howl Strides up to twice its Velocidad. If it ends its movement within its melee reach of at least one enemigo to which it's undetected, it can attempt two claw Golpes against that enemigo. Estos attacks count toward Desert's Howl's multiple attack penalización, but the multiple attack penalización doesn't increase until after Desert's Howl makes both of these attacks. Desert's Howl remains undetected to the criatura it's attacking until after resolving both of the claw attacks.

action->Nightmare Fuel.name: Nightmare Fuel
action->Nightmare Fuel.description: Desert's Howl's claws are infused with some of the nightmares that make up Desert's Howl's being, and they infect victims with lasting fear, cycling their victims' fears and anxieties in a horrific loop that takes time and rest to break. A criatura that takes daño from Desert's Howl's claw Golpe while asustado no longer reduces its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado} condition at the end of each turn. Instead, the criatura can only decrease its asustado condition by 1 after each full night's rest or with magical effects counteracting the fear, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EfFMLVbmkBWmzoLF]{Clear Mind}.

action->Paralytic Secretion.name: Paralytic Secretion
action->Paralytic Secretion.description: Desert's Howl's saliva is a potent paralytic substance that drains the energy from prey. A criatura hit by its spit Golpe must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} as well as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 asalto. If el objetivo was already drained, it instead increases the condition's value by 1, to a maximum of drained 4.

action->Profane Feast.name: Profane Feast
action->Profane Feast.description:
Requisitos Desert's Howl has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Efecto Desert's Howl begins to consume the criatura, dealing @Damage[(2d12+15)[piercing]] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:41|basic] salvación) and exposing the criatura to its paralytic secretion.

Despair Archdragon.publicNotes: Fear es one de el most powerful emotions, y despair dragones son masters de channeling those feelings de terror y hopelessness for su own benefit. As con otro oculto dragones, despair dragones son driven by un innate compulsion, en su case, el desire a strike terror en others. Despair dragones tend a settle near settlements, so ellos tienen un source de fear a draw de. El most common objetos en despair dragon hoards son scrolls, tomes, y relics que serve as research material. Through these, despair dragones learn de local folklore, urban legends, y more a better haunt su objetivos.

action->Inspire Dread.name: Inspire Dread
action->Inspire Dread.description:
The despair dragon telepathically communicates with a criatura within 90 pies, listing their deep-seated fears. The criatura takes @Damage[16d6[mental]] daño and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:45] salvación. Regardless of the result, the criatura becomes temporarily immune to Inspire Dread for 24 horas.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura takes half daño and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo The criatura takes full daño and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes double daño and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3}.

action->Look Behind You.name: Look Behind Tú
action->Look Behind You.description:
Desencadenante The dragon successfully Hides from a criatura within 90 pies

Efecto The dragon teleports to a space directly behind el objetivo criatura. The dragon immediately becomes detected unless their chosen position has cover or another means to remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}.

action->Shrieking Breath.name: Shrieking Breath
action->Shrieking Breath.description: The dragon lets out a cacophonous sound made of every scream the dragon has drawn from a terrified enemigo, dealing @Damage[23d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[will|dc:45|basic] salvación). Las criaturas who fail their Will save must spend the first action of their next turn doing nothing but screaming. The dragon can't use Shrieking Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Shrieking Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Tongue Decoy.name: Tongue Decoy
action->Tongue Decoy.description:
The despair dragon inflates several bladders at the end of its tongue to create the basic form of a criatura. Este process takes 1 minuto to complete, during which the dragon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}. If the dragon stops or is interrupted in this process, the bladders deflate, and the dragon must start over. Once the process is complete, the dragon can maintain the inflated bladders indefinitely, and can Dismiss to deflate the bladders and retract its tongue instantly.

The inflated tongue takes the basic form of an animal or humanoid and can be inflated to be either Small or Medium. The form resembles the general silhouette of a criatura, though closer inspection and success at a @Check[perception|dc:30] check can determine the true NATURE of the tongue. While inflated, the dragon can send its voice through the decoy, though keeping its tongue inflated makes it difficult to speak, causing the dragon to take a –4 penalización de circunstancia to any checks related to speaking, such as DECEPTION checks to Lie.

The dragon's tongue can extend up to 90 pies from the dragon's body and it can fully extend its tongue as part of the process to inflate the bladders. The dragon can move the inflated part of its tongue up to 15 pies at a time with an action, which has the concentrate, manipulate, and move rasgos. While extended, the inflated end of the tongue occupies space as a criatura of the appropriate size, but the rest of the tongue doesn't impede or block movement in any way. The dragon's scent functions through cilia at the end of the tongue, but otherwise the dragon has no means of knowing what's near its tongue.

Attacking the tongue is the same as attacking the dragon, except that the tongue is always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}. If the tongue takes any daño, it immediately deflates and remains out. The dragon remains desprevenido as long as its tongue is out, but the dragon can retract its tongue with two consecutive INTERACT actions. If the tongue takes daño, the dragon can't use its tongue decoy again for 1 día.

Devastation Cavalry Brigade.publicNotes: Among the troops sent by Oprak's Ironfang Legion to aid Nirmathas against the Molthuni invasion are its dreaded firestorm battalions, units with special training in the tactical use of bombs and explosives. Each of these battalions carries enough alchemical ordnance to bathe an entire battlefield in flame several times over.

action->Crushing Despair.name: Crushing Despair
action->Crushing Despair.description:
10 pies, @Check[will|dc:24]. Enemy criaturas that enter or begin their turn in the area must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result of the tirada de salvación, the criatura is then temporarily immune to the aura for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

action->Astride a Red Horse.description: Mientras moviendose en land, un devastation cavalry brigade ignores todos terreno dificil.

action->Mounted Troop.description: Effects que objetivo solo animals, humans, o humanoides puede no work en el brigade, subject a el DJ's discretion.

action->Rain of Ruin.description: The brigade draws or reloads their crossbows, then launches a ranged attack in the form of a volley. Diabolic Archdragon.name: Diabolic Archdragon
Diabolic Archdragon.publicNotes:
Hell, according to some theologians, is a living entity in and of itself. Diabolic dragons, these scholars argue, are just extensions of the plane, living criaturas that break off from Hell to enact its will. Whether this is true or whether diabolical dragons are simply the reborn souls of dragons sent to Hell, the fact remains that these dragons are powerful, cunning, and tyrannical. Every diabolic dragon's goal is to further Hell's will, though how this happens can vary. Regardless of their goals, these dragons always approach newcomers with an unsettling calmness.

Dragons come in myriad forms, with many having magical abilities or connections to magic. Some dragons draw greater power from magic than others, allowing them to manifest abilities or alter their physiques with prolonged exposure to magic. Estos dragons become more powerful as they age and strengthen their connections with their magical origins. Scholars debate the classification of these dragons, with some preferring the name magical dragons and others using traditional dragons due to their connection to specific magical traditions. Regardless of their names, these dragons share a number of characteristics: their ability to tap into magical energies, intensified might and cunning as they grow older, and an inclination to hoard vast amounts of treasure and wealth.

action->Hell's Sting.description:
Desencadenante The dragon is critically hit with a melee attack

Efecto The dragon channels the rancor of Hell back through the body of their foe, overwhelming it with an infernal assault on the mind. The triggering criatura takes @Damage[12d6[mental]] daño with a @Check[will|dc:46|basic] salvación. Holy criaturas use an outcome one degree of success worse than they roll on their tirada de salvación.

action->Diabolic Fire.name: Diabolic Fire
action->Diabolic Fire.description: Any daño de fuego that a diabolic dragon deals, including daño de fuego from conjuros, is imbued with the unholy power of Hell to scorch the spirit as well. A criatura takes daño de espíritu instead of daño de fuego if that would be more detrimental to the criatura (as determined by the GM). A diabolic dragon is immune to the diabolic fire of other diabolic dragons, the fire from divine immolation, and similar effects.

action->Diabolic Impalement.name: Diabolic Impalement
action->Diabolic Impalement.description:
Requisitos The dragon has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in its claw and doesn't already have a criatura impaled

Efecto The dragon attempts an ATHLETICS check against the criatura's Fortitude DC. On a success, the dragon drives the criatura through the bony protrusion on their chest, dealing @Damage[7d10[piercing]] daño (doubled on a critical success). The criatura is grabbed while on the protrusion and can attempt to Escape as normal. The dragon's claws become free to GRAB other criaturas, and the dragon doesn't need to use additional actions to keep the impaled criatura grabbed. If the dragon moves, they bring the grabbed criatura along with them.

An impaled criatura takes @Damage[2d10[spirit]] daño at the end of each of its turns, as the bone drives itself deeper to pierce the criatura's soul. If the criatura dies from this daño de espíritu, its soul becomes condemned to Hell. A criatura condemned to Hell in this way can't be resurrected except by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} ritual, divine intervention, or reclaiming the soul from Hell.

Draft Lizard.name: Lagarto de tiro
Draft Lizard.publicNotes:
Stout reptiles with scales in a checkered gold and white pattern, draft lizards sport powerful jaws and even stronger backs capable of hauling loads four times their own weight. Native to the underground tunnels of the Five Kings Mountains, the reptiles have been domesticated to serve as beasts of burden within the Depths and sprawling web of passages beyond. Zoologists theorize that they are a part of the same reptile family as zetogekis, as the two share a similar build and other physical characteristics.

Draft lizards within the vicinity of Highhelm have adapted their diet to feed mainly on grindlegrubs. However, residual behavior suggests in lean times or before domestication they would devour stones for sustenance. The animals can still be observed habitually gnawing on boulders or large stones, cracking them with their powerful jaws and seeming to savor the taste as they roll the debris around in their mouths. Overworked draft lizards will stray from their handler's control in order to consume rocks, only to return back to their path with a new undercurrent of purpose.

Normally as docile as any other beast of burden, the draft lizards of Highhelm will defend themselves if attacked by predators from the Darklands. Curiously, the lizards have an intense hatred for hryngars, attacking them without any prompting or hesitation. No dwarven records indicate teaching this behavior during the domestication of the animals, leaving its origins a mystery. Some caravanners even claim that the reptiles can sense the presence of hryngars, giving advanced warning of attacks by hissing menacingly into the darkness.

Though too large to be exceptionally dexterous, with careful training some draft lizards can be taught performative tricks. The Rolling Wheel is particularly known for a trio of reptiles that balance on their tails, catch hurled boulders in their jaws, and other stunts. The spectacle is well known in Highhelm, considered one of the big acts that the group performs. Este has led to some younger dwarves attempting to teach their animals the same feats, mostly resulting in failure and light property daño in the Depths.

Elder Wyrmwraith.name: Espectro del Wyrm anciano
Elder Wyrmwraith.publicNotes:
TDahak's defiance and his hatred for all of creation brought loss to dragonkind. It is said that the first wyrmwraiths rose from the souls of dragons hurled into the Void by Dahak, but whether this is true or not is still a matter of debate. What is undeniable is that the wyrmwraiths are unliving conduits of the Void, shaped but unshackled by the plane's hunger for indiscriminate destruction.

Wyrmwraiths dwell in remote areas marred by catastrophes and death, where they can better hide their undead NATURE or indulge in their grim research. Their lairs often have a single, hidden and highly defensible antechamber where the wyrmwraith confers with its agents as it engages in a war with distant rivals through expendable proxies. Este dimly lit antechamber is usually filled with death and many undead servants, some raised from the bodies of those whose usefulness has come to an end.

Wyrmwraiths might enter temporary alliances with other undead, cults, or necromancers, especially when it comes to unearthing powerful secrets or striking a blow against a common powerful threat. While wyrmwraiths take great pleasure in acting against those who wield the power of the gods, often targeting them first in battle to rend their flesh and protective conjuros with their claws, they are often very cautious, striking only after stacking the odds in their favor.

Eloko.name: Eloko
Eloko.publicNotes:
If a biloko is lucky enough to consume several spellcasters or other criaturas with innate magical abilities, they undergo a subtle transformation over the course of 1 week. Such a fey is known as an eloko, and in addition to their incredible appetite (even by biloko standards), they have the supernatural ability to grow to immense size.

Bilokos are crocodile-snouted fey who stalk the Mwangi Jungle and feast upon the flesh of humanoids. As cunning as they are vicious, bilokos employ deadly traps and guerrilla hunting tactics to capture prey-typically hapless explorers or, occasionally, wayward villagers, many of whom believe bilokos to be cruel ancestral spirits. The most powerful of these criaturas, known as elokos, wield potent transformative magic.

Bilokos have a fondness for bells, and the sound of ringing bells often indicates their presence. In addition to carrying and ringing them while out hunting, bilokos sometimes enchant bells with potent magic, or hang them on strings to serve as alarms for their encampments.

Bilokos look like slender but wiry humanoids with crocodile-like heads, rust-colored skin, and blood-red eyes. They eat only the meat of humanoids, though they can survive for extended periods of time on a single meal thanks to their snakelike ability to consume a Medium humanoid criatura whole. They do this by unhinging their jaws and slowly swallowing the victim from head to pies. Thanks to their acidic saliva and sharp teeth, a biloko can masticate their food into an easy-to-digest pulp, grinding flesh and bone into a compact mush, even while swallowing; thus, they do not flinch while devouring meals two or three times their own size.

A recently-fed biloko can be easily recognized by their sagging, distended belly. However, despite their slow appearance, the fey is no less dangerous then, as they delight in killing and might have hungry comrades hiding nearby, waiting to feed.

Empyreal Archdragon.name: Empyreal Archdragon
Empyreal Archdragon.publicNotes:
The three major celestial planes—Heaven, Nirvana, and Elysium—each have their own respective dragons. Empyreal dragons have a direct connection to Heaven. Using the blessings of Heaven, empyreal dragons protect others and intercede against wickedness. Empyreal dragons are wise, considerate, and compassionate. When speaking with others, empyreal dragons are patient and understanding.

Dragons come in myriad forms, with many having magical abilities or connections to magic. Some dragons draw greater power from magic than others, allowing them to manifest abilities or alter their physiques with prolonged exposure to magic. Estos dragons become more powerful as they age and strengthen their connections with their magical origins. Scholars debate the classification of these dragons, with some preferring the name magical dragons and others using traditional dragons due to their connection to specific magical traditions. Regardless of their names, these dragons share a number of characteristics: their ability to tap into magical energies, intensified might and cunning as they grow older, and an inclination to hoard vast amounts of treasure and wealth.

action->Divine Deflection.name: Divine Deflection
action->Divine Deflection.description:
Desencadenante The dragon is critically hit by an attack

Efecto Divine power intercedes, preventing some of the daño. The dragon gains resistance 20 to all daño against el ataque desencadenante.

action->Inspiring Presence.name: Inspiring Presence
action->Inspiring Presence.description:
60 pies.

The mere sight of an empyreal dragon motivates other criaturas. Las criaturas within the aura gain a +1 bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación and pruebas de habilidad. The empyreal dragon can't gain the benefit of their own aura or other actions that use the aura, and they can elige to exclude any criaturas from any benefit of the aura or action that uses the aura.

action->Direct Halo.name: Direct Halo
action->Direct Halo.description: The dragon tosses their halo to a square within 90 pies. While the halo is deployed in this way, the dragon loses their inspiring presence aura, and the aura instead emanates from the halo with the same emanation radius. The dragon can Sustain to recall the halo from any distance. The halo is made of pure light—it doesn't occupy space and can't be targeted or destroyed in any way.

action->Halo Pulse.name: Halo Pulse
action->Halo Pulse.description:
The dragon chooses one effect to impose on criaturas in their inspiring presence aura.

The dragon can't use Halo Pulse again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Halo Pulse]]{1d4 rounds}.

  • Repulsion Each criatura must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:46] salvación or be pushed until it's no longer in the aura.
  • Restoration (healing, vitality) Each criatura recovers @Damage[11d8[healing]]{11d8 Puntos de Golpe}.
  • Restriction (incapacitation, mental) Las criaturas must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:46] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure) while they remain within the aura. Regardless of the result, a criatura is then temporarily immune to restriction for 1 minuto.

action->Luminous Form.name: Luminous Form
action->Luminous Form.description: The dragon transforms into a being of pure light for 1 minuto, shedding bright light in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. While in their heavenly form, the dragon's melee Golpes deal an additional @Damage[1d6[fire]|options:area-damage] daño and @Damage[1d6[spirit]|options:area-damage] daño. Las criaturas with the unholy rasgo that can see the light must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:46] salvación or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 asalto (blinded for 1 minuto on a critical failure); they are then temporarily immune for 1 minuto.

action->Spirit Breath.name: Spirit Breath
action->Spirit Breath.description:
The dragon unleashes a blast of holy fire that deals @Damage[19d8[spirit]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:46|basic|options:area-effect] salvación).

The dragon can't use Spirit Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Force Body.name: Force Body
action->Force Body.description: Un ethereal sailor's cuerpo es made de force. It puede't usar ataque actions. It puede mover y usar actions necessary a pilot o crew un boat o ship. It puede't leave su boat o ship.

Executor Archdragon.name: Executor Archdragon
Executor Archdragon.languages: Plus one additional language spoken by celestials, Fiends, Or monitors as appropriate, Truespeech
Executor Archdragon.publicNotes:
Legends state the first executor dragons formed from the rage-filled screams of Sarenrae during her struggle against the Rough Beast. In the face of an enemigo even she had no hope of redeeming, the ever-compassionate Dawnflower allowed her divine fury to escape from her lips as she struck down the primordial god, and from this act of anathema, the first executor dragons were given form. Since that moment, executor dragons represent the full wrath of the gods. Divine in NATURE, executor dragons typically appear to punish those who have strayed so far from the path of their deity's edicts as to begin embracing the anathema. Due to their potent NATURE as armas of the divine, executor dragons are generally drawn to target not a single misbehaving follower, but entire villages, cities, or towns that have turned their backs on their gods. Many of the gods prefer not to use executor dragons as part of their punishment of mortal transgressors, and instead keep them reserved for the days of apocalyptic battles.

Though many believe executor dragons are spawned from divine magic, they are fully biological criaturas. Compelled by faith and devotion and disgusted by hypocrisy and base cruelty, executor dragons tend to live near human settlements, but rarely within them. They form small familial groups when young, but grow more independent as they age, seeking to claim territory uninhabited by other dragons. Their chosen lairs tend to be locations secreted away, either in the ruins of mountaintop monasteries or in the cavernous depths beneath abandoned places of worship. For the few executor dragons that live actively among non-draconic peoples, even fewer do so in their natural forms. They are sometimes found living disguised as traveling lay priests who bring healing and alms for the needy, choristers singing hymnals, wandering monastic scholars who ask challenging and conflicted questions about faith, or quiet church custodians who protect and beautify their chosen houses of worship. It's said that one or more executor dragons might have even taken up the defense of Kenebres after its near destruction at the hands of the Khorramzadeh, Storm King of the Worldwound.
Executor Archdragon.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra efectos divinos

60 pies. The divine majesty of an adult executor dragon can't be denied. A criatura that enters or begins their turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:44] salvación. Regardless of the result of the tirada de salvación, the criatura is temporarily immune to this dragon's aura of authority for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minuto.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minuto.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 10 minutos.

action->Rage of the Divine.name: Furia de lo divino
action->Rage of the Divine.description:
Desencadenante The dragon is critically hit by an attack

Efecto Raw divine power flashes through the executor dragon harming anyone who dares strike it so brazenly. The criatura who dealt el ataque desencadenante takes @Damage[8d8[spirit]] daño with a @Check[will|dc:41|basic] salvación.

action->Apocalyptic Roar.name: Apocalyptic Roar
action->Apocalyptic Roar.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The executor archdragon calls down the full power of the divine. All criaturas in a @Template[type:burst|distance:30] within 120 pies take @Damage[9d8[sonic]|options:area-damage] daño plus @Damage[6d12[spirit]|options:area-damage] daño, with a @Check[will|dc:44|basic] salvación.

Executor Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster).languages: Plus one additional language spoken by celestials, Fiends, Or monitors as appropriate, Truespeech
Executor Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster).publicNotes:
Legends state the first executor dragons formed from the rage-filled screams of Sarenrae during her struggle against the Rough Beast. In the face of an enemigo even she had no hope of redeeming, the ever-compassionate Dawnflower allowed her divine fury to escape from her lips as she struck down the primordial god, and from this act of anathema, the first executor dragons were given form. Since that moment, executor dragons represent the full wrath of the gods. Divine in NATURE, executor dragons typically appear to punish those who have strayed so far from the path of their deity's edicts as to begin embracing the anathema. Due to their potent NATURE as armas of the divine, executor dragons are generally drawn to target not a single misbehaving follower, but entire villages, cities, or towns that have turned their backs on their gods. Many of the gods prefer not to use executor dragons as part of their punishment of mortal transgressors, and instead keep them reserved for the days of apocalyptic battles.

Though many believe executor dragons are spawned from divine magic, they are fully biological criaturas. Compelled by faith and devotion and disgusted by hypocrisy and base cruelty, executor dragons tend to live near human settlements, but rarely within them. They form small familial groups when young, but grow more independent as they age, seeking to claim territory uninhabited by other dragons. Their chosen lairs tend to be locations secreted away, either in the ruins of mountaintop monasteries or in the cavernous depths beneath abandoned places of worship. For the few executor dragons that live actively among non-draconic peoples, even fewer do so in their natural forms. They are sometimes found living disguised as traveling lay priests who bring healing and alms for the needy, choristers singing hymnals, wandering monastic scholars who ask challenging and conflicted questions about faith, or quiet church custodians who protect and beautify their chosen houses of worship. It's said that one or more executor dragons might have even taken up the defense of Kenebres after its near destruction at the hands of the Khorramzadeh, Storm King of the Worldwound.
Executor Dragon (Ancient, Spellcaster).saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra efectos divinos

Failed Prophet.name: Failed Prophet
Failed Prophet.publicNotes:
Following el teachings de Kalistrade es un lifelong commitment. It requires studious adherence a el strictures y taboos laid out en el Prophecies. El ultimate reward for el devout es el promise de un personalized afterlife, filled con un lifetime de wealth y free de Pharasma's judgment. Not todos who learn de these final revelations son up a el task, however. For el fortunate ones, un simple death es el solo consequence for botching el ritual. For el less fortunate, el outcome es un undying half-life de torment. Caught between un twisted mockery de su imagined afterlife y el mortal Universe, un failed prophet va a know no peace until su cuerpo es destruido.

Un failed prophet resembles el skinless corpse de un humanoide ancestry covered en glowing, golden veinlike cracks. On closer inspection, el organs y musculature son unnaturally smooth y shiny, like cured y buffed leather.

action->Wealthsense.name: Wealthsense
action->Wealthsense.description:
150 gp

The failed prophet can detect concentrations of coinage and other valuables as an imprecise sense with a range of 60 pies. The failed prophet detects any criatura carrying coins and treasure totaling at least the average cost of a consumable item of the failed prophet's level.

action->Broken Mindscape.name: Broken Mindscape
action->Broken Mindscape.description:
30 pies, @Check[will|dc:27].

A criatura entering the aura or starting its turn in the aura must attempt a Will save. Use the moderate conjuro DC for the failed prophet's level.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and becomes immune to broken mindscape for 1 minuto.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} as disjointed visions of the failed prophet's mindscape assail its senses.

Fallo The criatura's mind is pulled into the failed prophet's mindscape. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 asalto. While paralyzed, the criatura can take any actions with the mental or spirit rasgos, or that deal mental or daño de espíritu, as though those actions were purely mental. Such actions only have line of effect to the originating failed prophet and other criaturas currently paralyzed by broken mindscape, though they treat all such criaturas as though they were adjacent.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the duration is 1 minuto or until the failed prophet is destroyed, whichever happens first.

action->Taboos.name: Taboos
action->Taboos.description: Despite the failed prophet's transformed body, a lifelong adherence to the strictures of the Prophecies of Kalistrade has ingrained the philosophical prohibitions into their soul. Siempre que a failed prophet is critically hit by an ataque sin armas, is critically hit by or critically fails a save against a touch conjuro, or is exposed to a disease or poison effect (even though immune), they take a –2 penalización de estado to their AC, attack bonuses, DCs, Perception, tiradas de salvación, and skill modifiers for 1 minuto. Breaking other Kalistocratic taboos can also trigger this penalización at the GM's discretion.

Valuables in unlocked containers on el objetivo's person can be taken just as easily as those carried. On a critical success, the failed prophet steals double that amount. Five-Color Orchid Mantis.name: Five-Color Orchid Mantis
Five-Color Orchid Mantis.publicNotes:
Few criaturas appear as beautiful as the orchid mantises. Their elegant form and coloration resemble flowers, and many people adopt the delicate criaturas as short-lived pets. While these mundane insects aren't dangerous to humanoids, they can still bring down prey several times their own size. Unfolding from their flowery pose, orchid mantises lash out with blinding speed, even chasing foraging butterflies with their sharp-toothed arms and powerful bite.

Orchid mantises naturally live short lives that don't offer a great deal of time to gather spiritual energy. However, a mantis in a rich enough environment can extend their life span and grow to understand the elements. Estos criaturas become five-color orchid mantises and, despite their violent attitudes, are thought to be especially sacred to Qi Zhong. As such, these dangerous mantises are often avoided or placated while gathering herbs rather than driven off.

action->Floral Camouflage.name: Floral Camouflage
action->Floral Camouflage.description: When Hiding, the five-color orchid mantis is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} by any amount of leaves or petals, even if they aren't thick enough to make other criaturas concealed.

action->Elemental Expulsion.name: Elemental Expulsion
action->Elemental Expulsion.description:
Requisitos The mantis has an elemental rasgo from Color Shift

Desencadenante It's damaged by a arma Golpe

Efecto Elemental energy pushes back against the blow, giving the attacker a –2 penalización de estado to tiradas de ataque until the beginning of its next turn. If the arma contains material that matches the mantis's rasgo (such as earth for a thrown rock or fire for a lit torch), the mantis gains resistance 10 to all daño from this Golpe.

action->Color Shift.name: Color Shift
action->Color Shift.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The mantis attunes itself to one of five elements, changing color accordingly (yellow for earth, red for fire, white for metal, black for water, or green for wood). It gains that rasgo and a +2 bonificador de estado to tiradas de salvación against effects with that rasgo until the beginning of its next turn. If the mantis uses Color Shift on its next turn, it must elige a different color.

action->Harvesting Limbs.name: Harvesting Limbs
action->Harvesting Limbs.description: The mantis makes two leg attacks. If both attacks hit, the mantis gains 10 Puntos de Golpe temporales, and el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] tirada de salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} on a critical failure). The drained condition ends when the mantis is reduced to 0 Puntos de Golpe.

action->Sudden Strike.name: Sudden Golpe
action->Sudden Strike.description: On the first round of combat, criaturas that haven't acted are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the mantis.

Fleshforged Conformer.name: Fleshforged Conformer
Fleshforged Conformer.publicNotes:
Shapeshifting fleshforged conformers have adapted to survive Ecanus's high-magic, population-dense sprawl. Resembling blocky humanoid skeletons splotched in uneven layers with cartilage and muscle, conformers are capable of attaching and detaching flesh from their bodies, often sending autonomous gobbets of fat and ligament to observe living criaturas and harvest biological material.

Fleshforged conformers use their resources to augment and change their bodies, which helps them infiltrate Nexian SOCIETY to better understand the arcane principles and occult secrets behind their creation. Some assume the guises of humans and animals to lead quiet, settled lives in Nex, but most are discovered and summarily exterminated as defects and threats to public safety.

action->Conformance.name: Conformance
action->Conformance.description: The conformer contorts and reshapes their body into a desired form. The conformer takes on the specific appearance of any Small, Medium, or Large humanoid or animal that they've observed and whose appearance they remember. Este doesn't change the conformer's Velocidad or their attack and daño bonus with their Golpes, but might change the tipo de daño their Golpes deal.

action->Surgical Detachment.name: Surgical Detachment
action->Surgical Detachment.description: El conformer detaches part de su cuerpo a serve them as un autonomous organism. For el next 24 horas, el conformer obtiene el loyal service de un fleshforged @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.lost-omens-bestiary.Actor.LVY9JAhTnBC2SeqZ]{Skinskitter}. As long as ellos remain dentro de 1 mile de cada otro, el conformer puede usar el Surgical Detachment action de nuevo a empathically direct el actions de su skinskitter servant as well as perceive through su sentidos. Due a how taxing este process es, el conformer puede tienen solo one skinskitter servant at un time.

action->Tissue Siphon.name: Tissue Siphon
action->Tissue Siphon.description:
Requisitos The conformer is within reach of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or willing criatura, or a criatura taking daño persistente de sangrado

Efecto The conformer touches and absorbs some of the criatura's flesh. El objetivo must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] salvación; on a failure, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and take daño from their daño persistente de sangrado, even though it isn't the end of their turn.

action->Wear Flesh.name: Wear Flesh
action->Wear Flesh.description:
Requisitos The conformer has used Tissue Siphon to absorb flesh within the last hour

Efecto The conformer expends the flesh they've absorbed to transform their body, reproducing the effects of one of the following conjuros: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GUnw9YXaW3YyaCAU]{Adapt Self}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SDkIFrrO1PsE02Kd]{Shifting Form}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.i8PBZsnoCrK7IWph]{Tentacular Limbs}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ddKBoCjmSyPSHcws]{Unusual Anatomy}. The Wear Flesh action gains the rasgos of the conjuro it's reproducing, and the conformer can Sustain a Spell on these effects.

Fleshforged Dreadnought.name: Fleshforged Dreadnought
Fleshforged Dreadnought.publicNotes:
Created in the arcane fleshforges of Nex, this criatura was spawned as the ultimate brute-force tool for urban assaults against the cities of Geb. At 30 pies tall, the dreadnought easily tops most city walls, and Nexian infantry forces would scramble up the spikes on the criatura's back to penetrate defensive fortifications. Every detail of the criatura's physiology was fashioned for the battlefield, from the ballista of bone and sinew integrated into its torso to the bulky ram on the crest of its head. The fleshforged's acidic blood not only serves an important hydraulic function but also deters city defenders who might attempt to strike down the criatura.

During the war between Nex and Geb, fleshforged dreadnoughts most often appeared as part of a coordinated assault and typically replaced or augmented an army's compliment of siege weaponry. Common tactics employed by Nex's generals would direct the dreadnought to crush all opposition standing in front of a city's gate and then smash through it. Should the city's defenses prove resilient, invading troops would scale the criatura to get over the city walls, relying on the dreadnought's regenerative properties to ensure it wouldn't be destroyed while helping them bypass the defensive barriers.

Fleshforged dreadnoughts all but vanished after the disappearance of the archmage Nex, but tales of their destructive power have been preserved.

action->Scaling Spikes.name: Scaling Spikes
action->Scaling Spikes.description: A fleshforged dreadnought is covered in handholds and footholds that make it easy to CLIMB. Las criaturas of Medium or smaller size can CLIMB the dreadnought, sharing one of its spaces as they do so. The DC to CLIMB a fleshforged dreadnought is 15, and criaturas move 5 more pies on a success and 10 more pies on a critical success, to a maximum of their Velocidad when Climbing the construct.

action->Drown in Ichor.name: Drown in Ichor
action->Drown in Ichor.description: The fleshforged dreadnought releases a wave of caustic fluid from vents in its sides. Forest Archdragon.name: Forest Archdragon
Forest Archdragon.publicNotes:
"Never pick a wildflower tienes not paid for, unless tú dare risk the wrath of a dragon." Este saying, and its variations, reflect the trepidations continental Tian Xia holds toward the forest dragon. The botanical dragons are considered wardens over life, plants, and the element of wood. Other imperial dragons seek them for their instincts and long memory, which make forest dragons invaluable consultants and decision makers during moments of crisis.

Like the rest of their imperial cousins, the forest dragon likely originated from the elemental plane they embody, namely the Plane of Wood. That some forest dragons yet reside in the recently returned Eternal Forest supports this theory, though this only answers the location of origin, not how the dragons came to be. The Elemental Lord Shumunue might resemble a forest dragon, but she is not one herself, so the mystery of the dragons' progenitor remains unanswered to this day.

action->Azure Swarm Breath.name: Azure Swarm Breath
action->Azure Swarm Breath.description: The dragon unleashes a swarm of insects that deals @Damage[20d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:45|basic|options:area-effect] salvación) before dispersing. A criatura that critically fails takes @Damage[4d6[persistent,poison]|options:area-damage] daño. The dragon can't use Azure Swarm Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Azure Swarm Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Coiling Frenzy.name: Coiling Frenzy
action->Coiling Frenzy.description: The dragon makes one claw Golpe and one tail Golpe in either order, each against the same target. If either Golpe hits, the dragon can attempt to GRAB el objetivo with that limb as a free action. The dragon can have up to three criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} at a time; one in each of their two front claws, and one with their tail.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Azure Swarm Breath siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Draining Blight.name: Draining Blight
action->Draining Blight.description:
Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto The dragon draws moisture from the living criaturas surrounding them to heal their own wounds. Each living criatura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] takes @Damage[12d10[void]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[fortitude|dc:45|basic|options:area-effect] salvación). Las criaturas made entirely of water and plant criaturas use the outcome one degree of success worse than they rolled. The dragon regains Puntos de Golpe equal to half of the highest daño a single criatura takes from this effect. All non-criatura plant life in the area withers and dies, eliminating non-magical undergrowth and any associated difficult terrain, cover, and concealment.

action->Forest Shape.name: Forest Shape
action->Forest Shape.description: Cuando casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dileJ0Yxqg76LMvu]{One con plantas}, un bosque dragon puede quedan un tree de el mismo size y age as themselves, using su own CA.

Fortune Archdragon.name: Fortune Archdragon
Fortune Archdragon.publicNotes:
Fortune dragons have the innate ability to draw upon the raw magical energies that surround them. They constantly use these magical energies to empower their magical abilities and even their bodies, as the energy can heal wounds. A fortune dragon has a typical build for an arcane dragon, but their bodies sport a striking feature: their treasure. The dragon's NATURE of drawing upon magic causes coins, gems, and, most notably, magical items to cling to their body like iron drawn to magnets. A dragon constantly pulls magical energies from the items attached to their body and makes use of these energies to cast conjuros. The magical energies that flow through a fortune dragon constantly flow through the dragon's items as well, and in many cases, the items melt from the heat produced in this process. Fortune dragons are seekers of novel experiences. Este desire for originality leads fortune dragons to approach visitors of other ancestries with curiosity, though this initial interest quickly wanes if a visitor lacks exciting qualities.

Dragons come in myriad forms, with many having magical abilities or connections to magic. Some dragons draw greater power from magic than others, allowing them to manifest abilities or alter their physiques with prolonged exposure to magic. Estos dragons become more powerful as they age and strengthen their connections with their magical origins. Scholars debate the classification of these dragons, with some preferring the name magical dragons and others using traditional dragons due to their connection to specific magical traditions. Regardless of their names, these dragons share a number of characteristics: their ability to tap into magical energies, intensified might and cunning as they grow older, and an inclination to hoard vast amounts of treasure and wealth.

action->Capture Spell.name: Capture Spell
action->Capture Spell.description:
Desencadenante The dragon succeeds or critically succeeds on a tirada de salvación against a conjuro

Efecto The dragon attempts to capture a portion of the conjuro's magic to feed themself. They attempt to counteract the conjuro (counteract rank 10, counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+42 #Counteract]]{+42}). Fortune Archdragon (Spellcaster).name: Fortune Archdragon (Spellcaster)
Fortune Archdragon (Spellcaster).publicNotes:
Fortune dragons have the innate ability to draw upon the raw magical energies that surround them. They constantly use these magical energies to empower their magical abilities and even their bodies, as the energy can heal wounds. A fortune dragon has a typical build for an arcane dragon, but their bodies sport a striking feature: their treasure. The dragon's NATURE of drawing upon magic causes coins, gems, and, most notably, magical items to cling to their body like iron drawn to magnets. A dragon constantly pulls magical energies from the items attached to their body and makes use of these energies to cast conjuros. The magical energies that flow through a fortune dragon constantly flow through the dragon's items as well, and in many cases, the items melt from the heat produced in this process. Fortune dragons are seekers of novel experiences. Este desire for originality leads fortune dragons to approach visitors of other ancestries with curiosity, though this initial interest quickly wanes if a visitor lacks exciting qualities.

Dragons come in myriad forms, with many having magical abilities or connections to magic. Some dragons draw greater power from magic than others, allowing them to manifest abilities or alter their physiques with prolonged exposure to magic. Estos dragons become more powerful as they age and strengthen their connections with their magical origins. Scholars debate the classification of these dragons, with some preferring the name magical dragons and others using traditional dragons due to their connection to specific magical traditions. Regardless of their names, these dragons share a number of characteristics: their ability to tap into magical energies, intensified might and cunning as they grow older, and an inclination to hoard vast amounts of treasure and wealth.

Draconic Spellcasters

Each dragon features a sidebar on spellcasting dragons of that type. To make a dragon spellcaster, remove the dragon's Draconic Frenzy and Draconic Momentum abilities, and give them the conjuros outlined in their sidebar. Puedes swap out any number of these with other conjuros, provided tú keep the same number of conjuros for each rank. Tú might also want to increase the dragon's INTELLIGENCE, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier by 1 or 2 to reflect their mastery of magic.

Gau Cho Rong.name: Gau Cho Rong
Gau Cho Rong.publicNotes: Campfire stories claim gau cho rongs originated as the ghosts of poachers' prey come back for revenge, concocted minions of hags, or cursed beasts that became addicted to the flesh of children who wander where they're told not to. Known by the unsettling nickname of "hollow bears," gau cho rongs are easily mistaken for their good-natured cousin, the sun bear. Little more than 3 pies tall with long, lolling tongues, they resemble adorable little cubs when glutted but turn into terrors when they begin to hunger and hollow. The hungry gau cho rong's pelt goes slack until it appears little more than brittle bone in a sack of fur, like an old doll shucked of its filling. The hollow bears writhe and whimper, luring sympathetic victims or opportunistic hunters. As these targets approach, other gau cho rongs drop down from the boughs above on the backs and faces of their prey, their loose fur dulling most attacks as they rake victims with their long, hooked claws. Once they've finally eaten their fill, the gau cho rongs revert to their disarmingly endearing state. Thus continues their life of playing, hunting, lazing, slaying, romping, and rending.
Gau Cho Rong.privateNotes:
Subsumed Traits

Physical changes from criaturas they've devoured are visible in markings on the gau cho rong's loose hide and even in the shape of its bony frame, granting different hollow bears slightly different abilities even among the same group. It's possible that unique, older, or more powerful gau cho rongs might gain permanent abilities from digesting certain criaturas.

action->Full Belly.name: Full Belly
action->Full Belly.description: When a gau cho rong is full, which requires consuming an entire Medium criatura or 6 Bulk of meat, it becomes peaceful and even playful. It has an automatic result of 33 on DECEPTION checks and DCs to pass as a normal sun bear, but it loses its resistances. A gau cho rong remains full for 8 hours.

action->Subsumed Traits.name: Subsumed Traits
action->Subsumed Traits.description: After it finishes digesting a full meal, the gau cho rong will gain a rasgo from that criatura until the next time it's full. Gau cho rongs that gain the animal rasgo have scent out to 60 pies as an imprecise sense, while those with the amphibious or aquatic rasgo gain a swim speed of 25 pies. Humanoid hollow bears gain the Reactive Golpe reaction. Traits like fire add that tipo de daño to a gau cho rong's resistances. Other rasgos have effects at the GM's discretion.

Giant Orchid Mantis.name: giant Orchid Mantis
Giant Orchid Mantis.publicNotes:
Few criaturas appear as beautiful as the orchid mantises. Their elegant form and coloration resemble flowers, and many people adopt the delicate criaturas as short-lived pets. While these mundane insects aren't dangerous to humanoids, they can still bring down prey several times their own size. Unfolding from their flowery pose, orchid mantises lash out with blinding speed, even chasing foraging butterflies with their sharp-toothed arms and powerful bite.

Estos mantises have grown to an unusual size, which makes their camouflage less effective in most environments. As such, they're usually found in areas where a blossom the size of an adult human could pass as normal, in the lushest rainforests, or in lands where rare medicinal herbs are cultivated. Tame giant orchid mantises can also be found protecting those rich enough to afford such decorative guards.

action->Floral Camouflage.name: Floral Camouflage
action->Floral Camouflage.description: When Hiding, the giant orchid mantis is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} by any amount of leaves or petals, even if they aren't thick enough to make other criaturas concealed.

action->Barbed Limbs.name: Barbed Limbs
action->Barbed Limbs.description: The giant orchid mantis makes two leg Golpes. If it hits the same criatura with both attacks, that criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until the end of the mantis's next turn.

Goldpebble.name: Goldpebble
Goldpebble.publicNotes:
Goldpebbles are large water snakes with bodies that, to the unassuming eye, appear to be nothing more than river rocks, some glinting with traces of gold. Estos terrifying criaturas mimic their natural surroundings to ambush greedy adventurers.

A Taldan alchemist created the goldpebble with the ultimate goal of breeding a criatura capable of reproducing at a high rate while possessing a body that would turn to gold upon death, effectively ensuring an endless supply of wealth. Initially, the experiments were successful, with each shed of the snake's skin producing trace amounts of gold. As the snakes grew, however, the amount of gold didn't, and the snakes themselves soon proved unwieldy and difficult to contain. Unhindered, the alchemist redoubled her efforts, adding alchemical reagents to her experiments and leaning more heavily into inhumane tactics to produce her desired results. Estos tactics failed to lead to an increase in the amount of gold produced but instead mutated the criaturas' venom, giving them the ability to slowly turn a victim's blood to frozen water. Empowered with this new ability, the goldpebbles felled their own creator and escaped to spread across the Inner Sea region.

Goldpebbles are generally solitary criaturas except for their biannual mating season. During this time, they're even more dangerous than usual, becoming territorial and protective of their young while attacking in groups. Once the eggs hatch, the breeding grounds are filled with hundreds of tiny snakes slithering in all directions in search of new territory. Estos young goldpebbles are less in control of their alchemical powers than their adult counterparts and have the potential to freeze the water around them at a moment's notice.

Goldpebbles rely heavily on ambush tactics. Often found hiding in shallow pools, rivers, and lakes, goldpebbles will lure unsuspecting adventurers to their lairs using their gold-flecked scales. Once within reach, goldpebbles attack with a gruesome bite that can poison an unlucky victim, slowly turning their prey's blood into freezing water. Goldpebbles can also chill the waters around them, making it incredibly difficult for prey to survive.

action->Chilling Currents.name: Chilling Currents

Grand Defender.name: Gran Defensor
Grand Defender.publicNotes: Hand-carved by the Father of Creation himself and strengthened by the souls of history's most heroic dwarves, the Grand Defender serves as Torag's herald across the planes. While a true messenger of a deity, the Grand Defender manifests itself in a unique way to other heralds. The chassis of the Grand Defender exists within Forgeheart, Torag's subterranean realm in Heaven. Este frame is empty, however, and can only serve basic functions, much like a golem. When faithful call upon the Grand Defender, Torag rouses the construct with spirits. As the might of the Grand Defender comes from Torag's will and the power of the souls within, the Grand Defender can take on any number of forms. Torag can send these spirits to alter any sufficiently sized statue of a dwarven ancestor. Este process temporarily converts the carving into the Grand Defender itself, complete with its abilities and equipment.

Graul.name: Graul
Graul.publicNotes: The labyrinthine caverns and tunnels beneath Highhelm are home to many dangers, with the insidious graul being one of the more notable native species. Estos highly specialized ambush predators possess a natural camouflage that renders them completely imperceptible to all forms of darkvision as they float silently through the darkness, allowing them to hunt criaturas that rely on specialized senses to navigate their lightless domain. Surprisingly cunning, grauls are adept at using their magical talents for illusion and mimicry to separate potential prey from allies and light sources alike.

<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]

action->Darkvision Invisibility.name: Darkvision Invisibility
action->Darkvision Invisibility.description: The graul's rubbery flesh is saturated with a unique biochemical compound that renders it undetectable by any form of darkvision. In dim or bright light, the criatura can be perceived normally by any kind of vision.

action->Oderless.name: Oderless
action->Oderless.description: The graul exudes no natural aroma, rendering it undetectable to criaturas using the scent ability.

action->Paralysis.name: Paralysis
action->Paralysis.description: A living criatura struck by a graul's jaws attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:20] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new check at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such check. A criatura paralyzed by this ability is also affected by the graul's darkvision invisibility for as long as the effect persists.

action->Seize.name: Aferrar
action->Seize.description:
Requisitos The graul has a criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with its tentacle

Efecto The graul pulls the criatura toward itself. The graul attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the criatura's Fortitude DC. With a success, the graul pulls the criatura 15 pies closer to it.

action->Sound Mimicry.name: Sound Mimicry
action->Sound Mimicry.description: The graul can perfectly imitate the sounds and speech of other criaturas by attempting a @Check[deception|against:will] check against a listener's Will DC. The graul doesn't need to understand the language it's mimicking, but when speaking a language it doesn't know, the criatura can only repeat specific words and phrases it has heard in the past 24 horas. The graul can't use this ability to duplicate voice-based abilities or conjuros.

action->Tentacle Grab.name: Tentacle Grab
action->Tentacle Grab.description: A criatura hit by the graul's tentacle becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the graul. The criatura isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, but it can't move beyond the reach of the graul's tentacle. A criatura can sever the tentacle with a Golpe against AC 18 that deals at least @Damage[10[slashing]] daño. Este deals no daño to the graul but prevents it from using its tentacle Golpe until it regrows the tentacle, which takes 1 asalto. A grootslang stands 20 pies tall, with skin like plated armor and a pair of massive forearms. It sports six deadly tusks capable of piercing flesh and bone with ease.
