Oprak Firestorm Battalion.name: Oprak Firestorm Battalion
Oprak Firestorm Battalion.publicNotes: Among el troops sent by Oprak's Ironfang Legion a aid Nirmathas against el Molthuni invasion son su dreaded firestorm battalions, units con special training en el tactical usar de bombs y explosives. Each de these battalions carries enough alchemical ordnance a bathe un entire battlefield en flame several times over.

action->Blaze of Glory.name: Blaze of Glory
action->Blaze of Glory.description:
Requisitos The firestorm battalion has been reduced to 2 segments

Efecto In the face of imminent defeat, the battalion detonates its remaining explosives to take its enemies with it. All criaturas within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10], including the battalion itself, takes @Damage[5d8[fire]|options:area-damage] daño with a @Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] salvación; a criatura that fails the save also takes @Damage[1d8[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage] daño. The battalion automatically critically fails this save and, should any members survive, can't use its Rain of Fire ability until it spend 8 hours CRAFTING a new batch of incendiary devices.

action->Close Ranks.name: Close Ranks
action->Close Ranks.description: The battalion raises a perfect guard against explosions and enemigo attacks. It gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia to AC and Reflex saves until the start of its next turn.

action->Rain of Fire.name: Rain of Fire
action->Rain of Fire.description: he battalion draws and hurls alchemical bombs with practiced precision. The bombs rain down in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 30 pies that deals @Damage[3d8[fire],1d4[persistent,fire]|options:area-damage]{3d8 daño de fuego and 1d4 daño persistente de fuego} daño (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] salvación). When the troop is reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a @Template[type:burst|distance:5]. Las criaturas adjacent to the burst take 1d4 daño de salpicadura de fuego.

action->Surgical Strikes.name: Surgical Golpes
action->Surgical Strikes.description:
1 to 3

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The battalion stabs with their pikes at enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] salvación). The daño depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d6+1)[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño

2 @Damage[(2d6+8)[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño

3 @Damage[(3d6+10)[piercing]|options:area-damage] daño

Orchid Mantis Swarm.name: Orchid Mantis Swarm
Orchid Mantis Swarm.publicNotes:
Few criaturas appear as beautiful as the orchid mantises. Their elegant form and coloration resemble flowers, and many people adopt the delicate criaturas as short-lived pets. While these mundane insects aren't dangerous to humanoids, they can still bring down prey several times their own size. Unfolding from their flowery pose, orchid mantises lash out with blinding speed, even chasing foraging butterflies with their sharp-toothed arms and powerful bite.

Some mantises have unusually strong connections to elemental power. Though they lack the training to cultivate this energy, when orchid mantises gather at a place of abundant food or overflowing natural energy, they can bring trees to bloom in the depths of winter or turn any stretch of ground into a garden. Despite their beauty, gathering in large groups only seems to exacerbate the mantises' tempers. Although the mantises are individually harmless, anyone disturbing the countless false blossoms is likely to be recognized as food, no matter their size.

action->Floral Camouflage.name: Floral Camouflage
action->Floral Camouflage.description: When Hiding, the orchid mantis swarm is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} by any amount of leaves or petals, even if they aren't thick enough to make other criaturas concealed.

action->Biting Blossom.name: Biting Blossom
action->Biting Blossom.description: Each enemigo in the swarm's space takes @Damage[3d6[piercing]] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] salvación). Las criaturas that fail this save also take @Damage[1d4[persistent,bleed]] daño.

action->Drifting Petals.name: Drifting Petals
action->Drifting Petals.description:
The swarm Flies. Each criatura whose space it moves through must attempt a @Check[will|dc:24] salvación or be transfixed by their blossom-like bodies.

Éxito crítico No effect.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 asalto.

Fallo The criatura is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 asalto.

Ort Mob.name: Ort Mob
Ort Mob.publicNotes: Pathetic masses de quivering flesh crafted de el souls de el damned, orts son el least de devilkind, making them el perfect cannon fodder for more powerful devils y mortal diabolists alike.

action->Faceless Horde.name: Faceless Horde
action->Faceless Horde.description: An ort mob is less organized than most troops. It can move into other criaturas' spaces, and other criaturas can move into its spaces. Its spaces are difficult terrain to other criaturas.

action->Grasping Claws.name: Grasping Claws
action->Grasping Claws.description:
1 to 3

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The ort mob claws at all enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] salvación). The daño depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[(1d6+1)[slashing]|options:area-damage] daño

2 @Damage[(2d6+5)[slashing]|options:area-damage] daño

3 @Damage[(3d6+6)[slashing]|options:area-damage] daño

action->Subservience.name: Subservience
action->Subservience.description:
An ort mob can be commandeered by any non-ort devil within 60 pies of it with a single action, which has the auditory and concentrate rasgos. The devil picks one of the following commands, and the ort mob follows it to the best of their ability. The command and its effects end once the commander is out of the mob's sight or when a new command is issued by the same or another devil.

  • Hustle The mob gains a +10-pies bonificador de circunstancia to its Velocidad until the command ends.
  • Kill The mob moves adjacent to one target singled out by its commander and spends all its available actions to use Grasping Claws until el objetivo is dead or the command ends. The targeted criatura takes a –1 penalización de circunstancia to its Reflex save against Grasping Claws and it takes an additional @Damage[1d6[slashing]] daño from the attack.
  • Rally The mob moves so that it shares a space with its commander. The commander doesn't treat the mob's spaces as difficult terrain and gains lesser cover while it's in the mob's spaces until the command ends.

  • Work The mob performs drudge work dictated by its commander.

Pagulin.name: Pagulin
Pagulin.publicNotes:
Pagulins are massive, multi-legged lizards that stalk the mountain passes of the Five Kings Mountains. Estos reptiles hunt elk and augdunars by lying in wait behind rock formations or within the openings of caves. Pagulins produce a mildly acidic saliva that they spit at prey to temporarily blind them before moving in for the kill. A pagulin's tail features a deadly thagomizer, four large spikes that it uses to impale prey to prevent their escape. Five Kings citizens know that pagulins are much smarter than they look, with many reports of pagulins intentionally allowing prey to escape, only to follow a criatura to its den and feast on its entire family.

Though pagulins are deadly, most in the Five Kings Mountains are indifferent to them. Pagulins tend to rest for days at a time after a hunt, spending time to digest their massive kills. They're particularly territorial, however, and will gladly rouse from a post-meal stupor to defend their lairs. The lizards are also known to attack anything that interrupts a hunt or scares off prey. Many merchant caravans have dealt with an unexpected pagulin attack after riding past a herd of startled deer.

action->Blinding Spittle.name: Blinding Spittle
action->Blinding Spittle.description:
A criatura hit by a pagulin's spit must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 asalto. It can use an INTERACT action to wipe away the spittle and remove the dazzled condition.

Fallo As success, except the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 asalto instead of dazzled.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the criatura is blinded for 1 minuto. The criatura needs 2 total INTERACT actions to wipe away the spittle.

action->Constrict.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.g26YiEIfSHCpLocV]

@Damage[(1d10+6)[piercing]], @Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic]

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Constrict]

action->Spike Rend.name: Spike Rend
action->Spike Rend.description:
Requisitos The pagulin has a criatura impaled on its tail;

Efecto The pagulin violently pulls its tail out of the criatura, dealing @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] daño to the criatura.

action->Tail Impalement.name: Tail Impalement
action->Tail Impalement.description: A criatura hit by a pagulin's tail becomes impaled on one of the tail's spikes. The criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}. If the pagulin moves, it brings the grabbed criatura along with it. The pagulin doesn't need to use additional actions to keep the criatura grabbed; the criatura remains grabbed as long as it's impaled. The grabbed criatura can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} as normal. Large and larger criaturas are immune to a pagulin's Tail Impalement.

Pathfinder Field Agent.name: Pathfinder Field Agent
Pathfinder Field Agent.publicNotes:
Este half-elf woman looks dressed to travel anywhere and prepared for any eventuality she might find along the way.

No two field agents follow the same path to join the Pathfinder SOCIETY, nor the same path once they embark on their first expedition. The SOCIETY's treacherous missions require all types of adventurers, from seasoned combatants to ruin delvers and experts in the occult. Some field agents are highly specialized, filling a single role in a larger group of Pathfinders, while others branch out into a broad range of abilities.

Este field agent seeks the thrill of discovering lost treasures from the Inner Sea's many ancient ruins. She scouts ahead for her team, keeping an eye out for enemies, traps, and other dangers. In fights, she is cautious and practical, preferring to stay mobile and out of sight. She sneaks in for a finishing blow when victory is certain.

The Pathfinder SOCIETY is a large and influential organization seeking to learn and share their knowledge to others, and its members can be found even in the least likely of places. PCs who are members of the Pathfinder SOCIETY might accompany a Pathfinder field agent or get news and assignments from a Pathfinder venture-captain.
Pathfinder Field Agent.saveDetails: +1 de circunstancia a todas las salvaciones contra trampas

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.zvLyCVD8g2PdHJAc]

Necesitas thieves' tools to Pick Locks or Disable Devices (of some types) using the THIEVERY skill.

If tu thieves' tools are broken, puedes REPAIR them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sw7MBLASN3xK4Y44]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to tu tools; this doesn't require using the REPAIR action.

la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.3Klm2gPmzOw6ntVb]

Este bitter draught opens tu mind to the potential of the written word. For the listed duration after drinking this elixir, puedes understand any words tú read, so long as they are written in a common language. Este elixir doesn't automatically allow tú to understand codes or extremely esoteric passages-tú still need to attempt a prueba de habilidad to Decipher Writing. The duration is 1 minuto.

consumable->Healing Potion (Minor).description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.2RuepCemJhrpKKao]

A healing potion is a vial of a ruby-red liquid that imparts a tingling sensation as the drinker's wounds heal rapidly. When tú drink a healing potion, tú regain @Damage[1d8[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

action->Scout's Warning.name: Aviso del batidor
action->Scout's Warning.description:
Desencadenante The field agent is about to roll a Perception check for initiative.

Efecto The field agent audibly or visually warns their allies of imminent danger. Este ability gains the auditory rasgo if the warning is audible, and the visual rasgo if the warning is visual. Any ally who is able to hear the agent (if the warning is audible) or see the agent (if the warning is visual) gains a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to their initiative roll.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.RxDDXK52lwyHXl7v]{Efecto: Scout's Warning}

action->Deny Advantage.name: Negar ventaja
action->Deny Advantage.description: The field agent isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to flanking, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} criaturas of 4th level or lower, or to criaturas of 4th-level or lower using surprise attack.

action->Mobility.name: Movilidad
action->Mobility.description: When the field agent takes a Zancada action to move half their Velocidad or less, that movement no desencadena reacciones.

action->Sneak Attack.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.AWvNPE4U0kEJSL1T]

The pathfinder agent deals an extra 2d6 daño de precisión to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} criaturas.

action->Surprise Attack.name: Ataque por sorpresa
action->Surprise Attack.description: On the first round of combat, any criaturas that haven't acted yet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} to the field agent.

action->Trap Finder.name: Buscador de trampas
action->Trap Finder.description: The field agent has an intuitive sense that alerts them to the dangers and presence of traps. They gain a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to Perception checks to find traps, to AC against attacks made by traps, and to saves against traps. Even if they aren't Searching, they still get a check to find traps. They can disable traps that require a proficiency rank of maestro in THIEVERY.

0.label: Trap Finder (detecting or defending against traps)

Pathfinder Venture-Captain.name: Pathfinder Venture-Captain
Pathfinder Venture-Captain.publicNotes:
The barnacle-crusted armor of this dwarf hints at a thousand exciting tales.

The venture-captains of the Pathfinder SOCIETY rose through the ranks of the organization by following a unique path. An individual venture-captain has overcome numerous challenges, and each has countless stories to tell-and the scars to go with them. Each venture-captain maintains a lodge somewhere in the Inner Sea, where Pathfinder agents can rest, share stories, and set out on new missions. The venture-captain assigns these missions themselves, and they can draw on the significant resources of the Pathfinder SOCIETY-as well as any local allies they have-to ensure the missions' success.

Este venture-captain operates a lodge that also serves as a tavern. His interest in epic tales led him to join the SOCIETY, and he gladly shares these stories with interested parties. Opportunistic field agents can gain the venture-captain's favor by recovering unique and valuable liquors. The venture-captain hopes to one day publish a Pathfinder Chronicle of his own.

The Pathfinder SOCIETY is a large and influential organization seeking to learn and share their knowledge to others, and its members can be found even in the least likely of places. PCs who are members of the Pathfinder SOCIETY might accompany a Pathfinder field agent or get news and assignments from a Pathfinder venture-captain.

spell->Inspire Competence.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f0Z5mqGA6Yu79B8x]
Inspire Competence

spell->Inspire Courage.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IAjvwqgiDr3qGYxY]
Inspire Courage

equipment->Wayfinder.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gbwr57aT9ou8yKWT]

Este compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones. It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder SOCIETY and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A wayfinder functions as a compass.

An indentation in the middle of the wayfinder can hold a single aeon stone. Placing an aeon stone in this indentation provides tú all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbiting tu head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. Tú invest a wayfinder and the aeon stone within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward tu investiture limit. Pearl Dragonet.name: Dragoncillo perla
Pearl Dragonet.publicNotes:
Pearl dragonets are fortune magic incarnate.

Nobody takes small, round dragonets seriously, but they're lucky to have around. Social and relatively defenseless, pearl dragonets have thrived by providing good luck in exchange for food and protection. Este reputation for bringing fortune—which the dragonets encourage—has led to the popularity of good-luck charms featuring this plump dragonet species and the belief that harming a pearl dragonet can incur a lifetime of ill luck.

Pearl dragonets have pearlescent scales and a round body with stumpy legs. Their minute wings cannot support flight, so they rely on magic to fly. They have long tails that can be up to five times the length of their bodies. Este odd build exacerbates their ungainly, waddling gait, which is punctuated by head-over-heel rolls and erratic flight paths.

Pearl dragonets are attentive, with an acute ability to understand the world around them. They are commonly found in the mountains of Tian Xia, living close to remote or insular highland communities that show due respect for their insight. Communities seeking to attract pearl dragonets often hang up round, red paper lanterns, though both the dragonets and the villagers take minor offense toward anyone who compares the relative shape of the dragonets and the lanterns.

Though dragonets are smaller and lacking the raw power of great dragons, they are every bit as varied and fascinating as their larger relatives. Like dragons, dragonets have strong ties to magic. Estos ties influence the contrasting natures exhibited by different dragonet types. For example, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.QIXc18xHrEWDmtKW]{Fey Dragonets} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core-2.Actor.Zh8awPHA7DZxTboc]{House Drakes} make fascinating pets and companions, and thus are a popular familiar for spellcasters. Tidepool dragonets, on the other hand, are arrogant and untamable.

Assuming dragonets are harmless due to their size, or the fact that they often live near people, is dangerous. Pest drakes, for instance, are weak and shy individually but are inclined to form dangerous swarms when unsettled. By contrast, pearl dragonets are gentle oddities that seem naturally friendly.

Dragonets range in size from little bigger than songbirds to no larger than house cats. Unlike most great dragons, they stop growing after reaching maturity. They vary greatly in INTELLIGENCE; fey dragonets are known for their tricks and wit, while feral racing drakes have the average problem solving capacity of a pigeon. Each type of dragonet has its own lairing and hoarding habits, and they have unique abilities that reveal their magical NATURE.

If the dragonet chooses fortune, all criaturas in the mist gain a bit of luck; the first time in the next round each affected criatura attempts an tirada de ataque or prueba de habilidad, they roll twice and use the better result.

If the dragonet chooses misfortune, each criatura in the mist must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] salvación.

On a failure, the first time in the next round that criatura attempts an tirada de ataque or prueba de habilidad, it must roll twice and use the worse result. The dragonet can't use Fortune Fog again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Fortune Fog]]{1d4 rounds}.

Peng.name: Peng
Peng.publicNotes:
A peng is a massive avian beast who flies effortlessly among the highest clouds. Their bright plumage makes it difficult to see their shape against an azure sky, but with patience, an onlooker might notice movement too swift to be a natural cloud.

Beautiful and graceful, a peng arises from the unlikeliest of origins: the cruel kun, a hateful fish monster whose predilection for the crushing depths of the sea matches the peng's own love of the bright, open sky. After a kun sacrifices their power for a noble heart by bathing in the sun's rays, they transform into this majestic bird, which eschews violence unless they must fight to stay free.

A peng doesn't seek danger or thrills; they want only to make their long voyages and fly without disruption. However, they sometimes come into conflict with dragons and other high-flying criaturas that would hunt them or block their path. Although it's unclear to mortals what purpose a peng's journeys serve, celestial powers related to air or freedom will sometimes ask their mortal followers to assist a peng in its journey.

A peng's calm and steady NATURE is so strong that its mere presence can quell storms and still winds. Spotting a peng is undoubtedly a sign of good luck for sailors and mariners—a feeling shared with most others lucky enough to lay eyes on these rare and beautiful criaturas. When the sky is clear and blue with gentle weather for an extended period, such fine conditions can be attributed to the presence of an unseen peng.
Peng.privateNotes:

Most pengs en Golarion son seen en el skies de southern Tian Xia. Pengs hardly ever roost o even stop a rest, y ellos're almost always spotted heading en un southerly trajectory. According a pengs themselves, ellos tienen no destination: ellos're headed south, y even ellos don't know why. Some whimsical pengs claim que ellos're en pursuit de un dream ellos once had en un life ellos lived long before este one.

Pest drakes are the feral descendants of valuable racing "pace drakes." Prized for their colors, speed, and homing ability, pace drakes have been bred, traded, and raced throughout Golarion. Their popularity invariably led to the establishment of feral populations, as these naturally nervous criaturas used their homing ability to establish protective flocks. Readily agitated, these rat-sized dragonets are dangerous in large numbers. They are easily overlooked in urban areas, however, as familiarity breeds complacency from those who see these dragonets every day with little incident.

Many pest drakes are a dun or dusty brown in color, though some flocks retain the brilliant blues, reds, and greens of their captive relatives. Both varieties have many tiny spines that resemble hairs and short, stubby noses that earned them the derogatory nickname of "dragon-winged rats." Much like other urban animals, pest drakes are highly adaptable, adept at scavenging food from trash piles or discarded foodstuffs. People likewise find the tiny dragons cute and will feed them, despite laws or warnings.

Pest drakes live in cities and ruins. They build their lairs atop hidden stone ledges and within inaccessible monument alcoves. There, their acidic mess often does irreparable daño before it is discovered and removed. Such lairs are usually full of tiny trinkets swiped off the street, such as earrings, coins, and nails they pull from cart wheels.

Pixiu.name: Pixiu
Pixiu.publicNotes:
To witness a pixiu (pee-shee-oh) is a blessing indeed—and a sight to behold. Este winged, dragon-headed lion has a formidable appearance that belies its youthful exuberance. Legend claims it was this overenthusiastic playfulness that caused the first of their kind to be banished from heaven, cursed to gather wealth and never let it go. Whatever the case, each pixiu has an uncanny ability to sniff out gold, which it loves to eat. Curiously, a pixiu's touch is also able to sunder curses and censure malign spirits, perhaps a remnant of its lost divinity.

Due to its celestial background and ability to exorcise curses, a pixiu is also believed to be a bringer and protector of prosperity, attracting good fortune and fending off evil spirits. Its heavenly origins and love of wealth may be the reason why imperial dragons have cared for them since time immemorial, valuing them as guardians and loyal companions. In particular, underworld dragons employ pixius to expand their hoards, and many sovereign dragons value them as status symbols. In dragon-ruled realms across Tian Xia, the presence of a pixiu within a community is seen as a sign of its draconic patron's approval and goodwill.

Despite the protection of imperial dragons, the lure of wealth is still enough to drive some to attack a pixiu. Although a pixiu will rarely forgive an attacker, it prefers to withdraw peacefully from those it judges as purehearted but desperate. A pixiu's draconic masters, however, aren't always as forgiving.
Pixiu.privateNotes:
Pixiu Dimorphism

Male and female pixius have notable differences (though, just like natural animals, individuals with the rasgos of both exist). Males have a golden coat and mane, while females have a blue overcoat. While most pixius have one horn, females with two horns aren't uncommon; curiously, no male pixius with two horns have ever been documented.

action->Goldsense (Precise) 120 feet.description: The pixiu can detect the presence, location, and approximate value of gold within 120 pies.

action->Stored Wealth.name: Stored Wealth
action->Stored Wealth.description: Pixius can eat gold and gems with no adverse effects. A pixiu's belly can hold any number of gold pieces, usually around 100. Siempre que it takes slashing or daño perforante, a number of gold pieces equal to the daño falls from its belly to the ground in its square.

Planar Tear.reset: Ebeshra vanishes 1 minuto after opening el rift, que closes el rift. Ebeshra debe wait 1 semana before ello puede open another planar rift.

Privateer Captain.name: Privateer Captain
Privateer Captain.publicNotes:
A faint crust of salt rimes the coattails of this mariner, and her steely eyes gaze from beneath the brim of her tricorne hat.

Dismissively called a pirate or thief by some, the privateer captain commands a loyal crew that plies the waters of the Inner Sea and beyond. Privateers work for their own profit and reputation, of course, but they also commit themselves to keeping the sea-lanes free from navies that strive to enforce land law on the unbounded waves. Tyrants and slavers are their favorite targets, and many a greedy colonizer or trafficker in flesh has been sent to the bottom of the sea after the captain liberated their cargo. Generally, however, the privateer captain is willing to spare prisoners so that they might be ransomed and spread tales of Firebrands' actions across the region.

The privateer captain is often at the vanguard of boarding parties. Many call on the power of the fickle goddess Besmara to strengthen their crew in battle and sanctify each shipboard raid. As at home in water as on deck, a privateer captain will gladly leap into the sea to pursue a foe or rescue a fallen crewmate. Though the privateer captain might run under a false flag or attempt to deceive a foe before battle, they generally honor agreements to surrender and make a point to keep their word, particularly when dealing with other Firebrands.

Wherever oppression or an opportunity for daring adventure can be found, the Firebrands can be found chasing after. PCs might find the Firebrands to be allies in a quest for righteous rebellion or justice against slavery, or they might find these dashing daredevils to be friendly-or not so friendly-rivals for the same treasure. The charming scoundrel presented here could easily be a low level freedom fighter or foil for the PCs, or might serve as crew for the privateer captain. An unusually large number of kaava living in the Kaava Lands are relatively small, standing about 3 pies tall and weighing about 30 pounds. Pygmy kaava openly show their disdain for larger kaava, and the two groups rarely get along. Pygmy kaava often hunt alongside entrenado bush vipers or black mamba snakes.

Kaava are stealthy, jungle-dwelling humanoids with short down feathers that can easily be mistaken for fur from a distance. Kaava have tough scales beneath these feathers. Both the scales and feathers have mutable pigmentation that allows a kaava to blend into surrounding foliage like a chameleon.

Quantium Golem.name: Quantium Golem
Quantium Golem.publicNotes:
The long war between Nex and Geb spawned many animate armas, but while a citizen of Quantium might run screaming from any product of the fleshforges, they barely bat an eyelash at the ground-shaking stomp of the two titanic, deadly constructs that stride outside their city walls. Crafted by the wizard-king Nex ages ago after a devastating attack by Geb's undead forces, including the harrowing benthic reaver, the Quantium golems are meant to protect the capital in case of Nex's absence. Estos twin golems ceaselessly keep vigil over the city, ready to cut down any invaders that menace Quantium.

Twenty pies tall and crafted from a supernaturally smooth material, the two guardians are a matched set, one of crimson and one of emerald. Wielding swords the size of giants, the guardians relentlessly destroy anything that threatens the city, particularly any undead that might invade the country from Geb. With the mythic Crux of Nex as a power supply, the golems are inexhaustible and nearly indestructible.

Rain-Scribe.name: Rain-Scribe
Rain-Scribe.publicNotes:
Este sharp-eyed half-elf wears weather-beaten gear that would easily blend in with any natural terrain, and carries an elaborately carved walking staff.

When a group of adepts leaves the Magaambya, whether to investigate a magical phenomenon, conduct a diplomatic mission, or visit scholars in a distant land, a Rain-Scribe often serves as their guide. An experto in travel through difficult environments, the Rain-Scribe provides for their companions while helping them avoid the many hazards of travel in the Inner Sea. Rain-Scribes are some of the most well-traveled members of the academy, and most have secured alliances or promises of safe passage through the lands where they walk.

Should the Rain-Scribe or their companions be attacked on their journeys, the scribe is a capable combatant who strives to turn their communion with the natural world into their greatest advantage in battle. Whether by using primal magic against their foes or striking unseen from the underbrush, the Rain-Scribe assures that no opponent threatens their traveling companions for long.

Incredible events have rocked the lands of Avistan over the past 10 years, from whole cities reappearing out of a loop in time to magical explosions vaporizing the prison of Gallowspire. Estos marvels, both terrible and awe inspiring, inevitably attracted the attention of the Magaambya academy, home of scholars of magic in all its forms. Scholars, emissaries, and spies alike have now established Magaambyan centers in the north, seeking to learn and to help those they can along the way.

Ratajin Mastermind.name: Ratajin Mastermind
Ratajin Mastermind.publicNotes:
Most commonly found in Vudra and Jalmeray, ratajin aren't so much twisted by curses as they are molded by the lingering effects of curses inflicted on generations millennia past. The difference lies in understanding the original ratajin characteristics. No curse gave ratajin four eyes on a slender face, nor triple-jointed, hypermobile legs and multiple arms. Nor did curses provide ratajin with skin tones of all hues within the color spectrum. Instead, these residual curses have given each ratajin distinctive geometric markings all across their body. Every ratajin also experiences a cursed twist on their senses, altering how they view and INTERACT with the world around them. Some ratajin visualize the world in shifted, indescribable color spectra. For others, sounds physically manifest as feelings on their skin. Haunting melodies of past actions might whisper in the wind behind one ratajin, while another can be awake only during hours devoid of sunlight.

While particular curse manifestations are passed along family lines, each ratajin's worldview can offer a unique perspective. Ratajin tend to be receptive to new ideas, making them well-suited to tackle complex situations. They often prefer to focus on difficult problems, working without rest until they reach a solution. What satisfies the definition of a worthy pursuit varies with individual ratajin, from tinkering with new applications of technology to uncovering secrets of centuries-old magical tomes. Their intellectual approach to problems can make ratajin especially useful in situations requiring delicate words, and their quick thinking serves them well as adventurers when the time comes for action. Estos same characteristics also make them capable merchants and scholars.

Earning a ratajin's trust can prove difficult. Their large-scale communities often collaborate to devise clever solutions that ensure equitable treatment among people, but each community varies greatly due to the different needs of the inhabitants. Outsiders who require too much help too quickly might cause a ratajin to withdraw, believing their guest incapable of adjusting to life's many hurdles. Poorly chosen words of pity or meaningless sympathy toward the NATURE of a ratajin's unique sensory experience can also cause lingering resentment.

Requiem Archdragon.name: Requiem Archdragon
Requiem Archdragon.publicNotes: Requiem dragones son stewards de el River de Souls y el process through que souls reach su final destination en el afterlife. El safe journey de un soul es de utmost importance a un requiem dragon, y some va a follow individual souls de su first entry into el river through a su judgment en el Boneyard y eventually a su ultimate resting place. Most requiem dragones tie themselves a specific planes y shepherd cualquier souls bound a que plane, leading a dragones linked a places like Heaven o Hell, though these dragones never swear true allegiance a these planes. Requiem dragones fill su lairs along el River de Souls—patchworks de somber architecture rescued de otro planes—con invaluable records y mementos de great accomplishments.

Resurrection Archdragon.name: Resurrection Archdragon
Resurrection Archdragon.publicNotes: Resurrection dragons teeter between life and death. They have a mastery of vital energies, allowing them to restore life to the dead, and a mastery of void energies, to bestow death on others. They make use of their abilities to play with the lives of mortals, calling on spirits to aid them or reviving criaturas they find important or interesting. The lair of a resurrection dragon is generally a barren place. While they still hoard wealth like other dragons, they do little to decorate their lairs and treasures are generally kept in dark niches, as if the dragon has little care for their possessions. Resurrection dragons tend to take tokens from those they resurrect or plan to resurrect, however, and these are kept particularly safe.

action->Arise!.name: Arise!
action->Arise!.description:
The resurrection dragon uses their mastery over life energy to cast their own soul into the Boneyard and pull a willing criatura's soul back to their body in a process that takes 1 hora. Este has the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IkGYwHRLhkuoGReG]{Raise Dead} except the maximum level of el objetivo is 18 and the soul is tethered to the dragon's. Only one criatura can be tethered to the dragon's soul at a time. If the criatura and the dragon are no longer on the same plane or the dragon dies, the raised criatura dies and can't be raised with Arise! again.

The dragon can Dismiss the connection at any time. Doing so doesn't prevent the dragon from raising the criatura with Arise! again. While raised in this way, the criatura is still a valid target for raise dead, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kqhPt9344UkcGVYO]{Resurrect}, and similar effects. Returning the criatura to life in this way fully restores the criatura, severing the connection to the dragon and allowing the dragon to establish a connection with a different criatura.

action->Reawaken!.name: Reawaken!
action->Reawaken!.description:
Desencadenante A living criatura the resurrection dragon can see dies

Efecto The resurrection dragon uses divine and vital energy to retether the soul to its dead body. The willing criatura is returned to life with half of their total Puntos de Golpe. A criatura can be resurrected by this ability only once.

action->Risen Commander.name: Risen Commander
action->Risen Commander.description: Un resurrection dragon tiene un strong connection con su minions y puede Sustain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9WGeBwIIbbUuWKq0]{Summon muertos vivientes} o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hghGRzOSzEl4UXdS]{Invoke espiritus} as un free action once per turn.

action->Siphon Life.name: Succionar Vida
action->Siphon Life.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 60 pies uses a healing effect that restores Puntos de Golpe

Efecto The resurrection dragon redirects vital energies away from the effect, minimizing its impact. The triggering effect rolls the minimum amount on any dice rolls to restore Puntos de Golpe, and any flat values for restoring Puntos de Golpe (such as the additional Puntos de Golpe for a two-action heal conjuro), are cut in half. The dragon then gains 4d8 Puntos de Golpe temporales that last for 1 asalto.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragon realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Soul Siphoning Breath siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Mortal Fears.name: Mortal Fears
action->Mortal Fears.description:
The archdragon imposes the fear of death onto the living and fear of the living onto the undead. Each criatura within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:120] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:46] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3}. A living criatura can't reduce its asustado condition below 1 if it ends its turn within 15 pies of the archdragon or an undead criatura. An undead criatura can't reduce its asustado condition below 1 if it ends its turn within 15 pies of the archdragon or a living criatura.

Fallo crítico As failure, but @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 4}.

action->Necro Puppeteer.name: Necro Puppeteer
action->Necro Puppeteer.description: The dragon siphons energy into an undead criatura, a dying criatura, or a corpse they can see within 60 pies. The dragon moves el objetivo criatura 30 pies and causes it to unleash a wave of void energy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10], dealing @Damage[8d8[void]|options:area-damage] daño (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic] salvación).

action->Soul Siphoning Breath.name: Soul Siphoning Breath
action->Soul Siphoning Breath.description: The archdragon unleashes a torrent of divine energy dealing @Damage[22d6[void]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[fortitude|dc:46|basic] salvación) that draws the life force from the criaturas within. The dragon gains curacion rapida 20 until their Soul Siphoning Breath recharges. The resurrection dragon can't use Soul Siphoning Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Soul Siphoning Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

Rime Archdragon.name: Rime Archdragon
Rime Archdragon.publicNotes:
Rime dragons are the embodiment of the frigid cold and ice. Estos hardy criaturas have adapted to harsh arctic climates, able to survive indefinitely in sub-zero temperatures. Rime dragons are shades of white and pale blue that perfectly camouflage them in their natural habitat, resembling glaciers or mounds of snow when curled up. They can break through large slabs of ice and dive into frozen waters in search of prey. Due to their natural lower body temperature, they can slow their digestive tract, which allows them to live a long time on little food. Large prey—such as whales, caribou, or moose—offer the best sustenance, but they aren't picky when it's time to eat.

Rime dragons have a deep curiosity for things hidden and lost in the ice. The ocean's currents bring all kinds of artifacts from across the world to their frigid waters. Self-described caretakers and scholars, rime dragons search the arctic regions for ancient antiquities. Rime dragons with an academic interest in archaeology peer into glaciers for pieces of civilizations both recent and ancient, which they preserve in their lairs. Others might search for fossils or preserved corpses. Rime dragons also have an interest in more biological aspects of the world. As preservers of life, some of these dragons collect flora to log and study, and they protect endangered species by using low temperatures to conserve them. They also act as paleopathologists, studying ancient diseases that could cause havoc if they were brought back to a populace unknowingly. Estos they carefully contain while researching mitigation strategies should the pathogens be reintroduced to the world.

Rompo.name: Rompo
Rompo.publicNotes:
Rompos are unusual criaturas that feed on corpses. They have thin, almost-skeletal bodies with strong rear legs that resemble a bear's, front legs like a badger's, and a head like a hare's with humanoid ears. A rompo tends to be timid on its own; it avoids other criaturas and typically flees in the presence of larger animals. Though no more intelligent than any other beast, it usually acts with extreme paranoia, dodging traps or ambushes with an uncanny acumen. When danger is present, a rompo utters a loud cry to afford itself space to run and hides by using its body's natural color-shifting fur as camouflage.

Although rompos sport the perfect physical features to act as predators, they tend to live their lives as solitary scavengers of leftover corpses. Rompos prefer to avoid hunting for themselves since they risk sustaining injuries in the process. It's not uncommon for rompos to follow other predators for hours, waiting for an opportunity to feast on the leftover remains of a hunt.

Once a rompo gains access to a meal, it takes several minutes circling the corpse to make sure the area is clear. As it begins to feast, it lets out a whimpering cry that fascinates and compels other criaturas to keep away so that the rompo can feed in peace. Due to its constant feeding on decaying flesh, a rompo's mouth is filled with rot, parasites, and deadly pathogens. Its bite can impart these combined infections as a dangerous disease known as rompo chills. The disease causes its victim to tremble uncontrollably, lightly at first but eventually developing into a violent shaking that ends with the victim's death. Despite their cautious NATURE, rompos always seem to linger close to criaturas they infect with rompo chills; though they remain unseen while the victim lives, they emerge when that victim finally succumbs, in order to feed on the corpse.

action->Camouflage.name: Camuflaje
action->Camouflage.description: The rompo can change its coloration to match its surroundings. It doesn't need cover to attempt to Hide with a STEALTH check.

action->Crooning Cry.name: Crooning Cry
action->Crooning Cry.description:
60 pies. The rompo hums in a low voice. Each criatura within the emanation must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:19] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} and compelled to move away from the rompo, traveling to the furthest edge of the emanation. Fascinated criaturas are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}.

The effect lasts for 1 asalto, but if the rompo spends a single action on subsequent rounds, it can extend the duration by 1 asalto for all affected criaturas. If the rompo attacks, the fascinated condition ends only for the criatura that is attacked.

On a successful save, a criatura is temporarily immune to Crooning Cry for 24 horas.

action->Rompo Chills.name: Rompo Chills
action->Rompo Chills.description:
El objetivo can't reduce its sickened condition while affected by rompo chills

Rune Archdragon.name: Rune Archdragon
Rune Archdragon.languages: Todos los idiomas comunes e infrecuentes, un idioma raro
Rune Archdragon.publicNotes: Rune dragons have an innate insight on the power of runes. Most rune dragons keep a variety of runes etched on their scales, which their bodies can magically empower. They typically don't cast conjuros themselves, instead relying on their ability to create runes on the fly to produce desired effects. A rune dragon often refers to their hoard as their library, as it's full of important historical texts, plays, speeches, textbooks, and spellbooks written by people of different cultures in a variety of languages. While they can often speak a language with the aid of magic, they much prefer to learn languages in the context of their speakers so they can grasp the nuances hidden within the syntax and the magic within their symbols.
Rune Archdragon.saveDetails: +2 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra efectos arcanos

equipment->Common runes of 18th level or.name: Common runes of 18th level or lower etched upon their scales

action->Magic Sense.name: Sentido mágico
action->Magic Sense.description: The rune dragon is aware of any active magical abilities and effects within the listed range. When the dragon Seeks, it gains the benefits of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} conjuro on the things it sees within the listed range (in addition to the normal benefits of Seeking).

action->Runic Scales.name: Runic Scales
action->Runic Scales.description: The rune dragon's scales function as runestones. The rune dragon can't use the effects or abilities of the runes etched on its scales, but can transfer these runes to appropriate objects. Transferring a rune to or from an item in this way requires 1 minuto to complete, during which the dragon is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido}. The process is automatic and doesn't require a check, but if the dragon stops or is interrupted in this process, the rune is destroyed. A rune dragon can have any number of runes etched on its scales, though they typically have only a handful of runes etched on their scales at a time.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Arcan.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Arcane

action->Canceling Rune.name: Canceling Rune
action->Canceling Rune.description:
Desencadenante The dragon is el objetivo of a conjuro that requires a tirada de salvación

Efecto The dragon attempts to unmake the conjuro's foundational runes. They attempt to counteract the conjuro (counteract rank 10, counteract modifier [[/r 1d20+42 #Counteract]]{+42}). If successful, the dragon is unaffected by the conjuro; other subjects are affected by the conjuro normally. The dragon can't use canceling rune again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge canceling rune]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Retributive Rune.name: Retributive Rune
action->Retributive Rune.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 15 pies damages the rune dragon

Efecto With a burst of runic magic, the rune dragon creates a detonating rune on the triggering criatura and immediately causes it to detonate if it didn't automatically do so.

The rune dragon gains an additional reaction at the beginning of each of their turns that they can use only for a Retributive Rune.

action->Detonating Rune.name: Detonating Rune
action->Detonating Rune.description: The rune dragon's Golpes and abilities can leave a detonating rune on their targets. If a criatura would receive a detonating rune while they already have one, instead of adding another rune, their current detonating rune activates, dealing @Damage[8d6[untyped]] daño to el objetivo and expending the rune. The detonating rune's tipo de daño matches the dragon's current Shifting Rune. A criatura can use an INTERACT action to remove the rune. Detonating runes fade after 1 minuto if not detonated.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Runic Breath siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Entangling Rune.name: Entangling Rune
action->Entangling Rune.description: The rune dragon creates large trapping runes in 3 non-overlapping @Template[type:burst|distance:15]s within 60 pies. Las criaturas other than the dragon that enter a trapped space or end their turn in the trapped space activate the rune, causing it to entangle the criatura. The criatura must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:46] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 minuto or until it Escapes. The rune can only trap a single criatura at a time. The rune vanishes either when a criatura succeeds against the rune, when a criatura successfully Escapes the rune, or after 1 minuto. A criatura adjacent to the rune can use an INTERACT action to remove the rune.

action->Runic Breath.name: Runic Breath
action->Runic Breath.description: The dragon launches hundreds of exploding runes that detonate upon impact, dealing @Damage[20d6[untyped]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:60] (@Check[reflex|dc:46|basic] salvación). The tipo de daño of this ability is determined by Shifting Rune. Las criaturas that take daño from the breath also gain a detonating rune. The dragon can't use Runic Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Runic Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Shifting Runes.name: Shifting Runes
action->Shifting Runes.description: The rune dragon chooses between acid, cold, electricity, fire, or daño sónico. The runes etched upon the dragon shift, forming runes of that energy on their scales. The dragon gains immunity to that tipo de daño, and their detonating runes and Runic Breath deal that tipo de daño. Anyone entrenado in ARCANA can immediately recognize the energy type of the etched rune without a check.

action->Trail of Runes.name: Trail of Runes
action->Trail of Runes.description: The rune dragon Strides, leaving behind a collection of runes wherever it steps. The dragon chooses to leave behind either detonating runes or entangling runes. Every space that the dragon moves through, including spaces occupied by criaturas, gains a rune. Estos runes automatically activate when a criatura other than the rune dragon enters the space or ends its turn in the space. The runes can otherwise be removed or vanish like normal.

Sacristan Scourge.name: Sacristan Scourge
Sacristan Scourge.publicNotes: Pressed into servitude by el shadowcasters de el Umbral Court, these shambling assemblies de scarred flesh, jagged metal, y darkness incarnate would be pitiable si ellos did no pose such un deadly threat a those who meet them en el battlefield. Each de these companies es made up de dozens de velstracs whose bodies y espiritus tienen been utterly roto by el agonies de el Netherworld. El horror de su brutal combat tactics es exceeded solo by el chilling howls que herald su arrival, shattering el minds de even el most disciplined soldiers. Once un battle tiene concluded, many members de un sacristan scourge search for those who fueron wounded but son no yet muerto a taste su exquisite suffering en su final moments.

action->Painsight.name: Painsight
action->Painsight.description: Each member of a sacristan scourge automatically knows whether a criatura they can see has any of the doomed, dying, and wounded conditions, as well as the value of those conditions.

action->Regeneration 10 (Deactivated by.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.lR9R5Vld8Eu2Dha5]
Regeneración 10 (Deactivated by Holy or Silver)

action->Staggering Servitude.name: Staggering Servitude
action->Staggering Servitude.description: 30 pies. When a criatura ends its turn in the sacristan scourge's aura, it is subjected to an overwhelming vision of the entire scourge groveling piteously before it. The criatura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:33] salvación or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

action->Focus Gaze.name: Focus Gaze
action->Focus Gaze.description: The sacristans stare at a criatura they can see within 30 pies. The criatura must immediately attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] salvación against staggering servitude. In addition, if the criatura was already aturdido, on a failed save its revulsion toward the sacristans' presence causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minuto. After attempting this save, the criatura is then temporarily immune to staggering servitude until the start of the scourge's next turn.

action->Shadow Scream.name: Shadow Scream
action->Shadow Scream.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto The sacristans open their mouths in unison to unleash a chorus of ghastly wailing infused with the mind-shattering darkness of the Netherworld. Este creates a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] of darkness and pandemonium around it that's impenetrable even to criaturas with darkvision (but not greater darkvision). They can Sustain Shadow Scream for up to 1 minuto. Non-velstrac criaturas in the area when the ability is used, as well as those that enter or start their turn in the area, must attempt a @Check[will|dc:33] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 24 horas.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 asalto.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} and deafened for 1 asalto.

Fallo crítico The criatura takes @Damage[60[mental]|options:area-damage] daño and is confused and deafened for 1 asalto.

action->Storm of Agony.name: Storm of Agony
action->Storm of Agony.description:
Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The scourge lashes with barbed chains against enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:33|basic] salvación). The daño depends on the number of actions. A criatura that critically fails is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

1 @Damage[1d8[piercing],1d6[spirit],1d4[bleed]]{1d8 piercing plus 1d6 spirit and 1d4 persistent bleed}

2 @Damage[(3d8+6)[piercing],1d6[spirit],1d6[bleed]]{3d8+6 piercing plus 1d6 spirit and 1d6 persistent bleed}

3 @Damage[(4d8+9)[piercing],1d6[spirit],1d8[bleed]]{4d8+9 piercing plus 1d6 spirit and 1d8 persistent bleed}

Sage Archdragon.name: Sage Archdragon
Sage Archdragon.publicNotes:
A shining, rune-inscribed scale is all that most people, even adventurers, see of a sage dragon during their lifetimes. Even then, only those familiar with dragon LORE will likely recognize the scale as anything other than an elaborate conjuro scroll. Collectors and scholars of esoteric LORE, sage dragons become increasingly reclusive as they age, and, even in their youths, they're prone to work through trusted intermediaries. For those able to locate and gain the trust of such a criatura, even the youngest sage dragons are fonts of difficult-to-find knowledge and rare magical techniques. The oldest sage dragons are living combinations of gargantuan libraries and endless grimoires, accumulating the secrets of the Universe, and beyond, in their isolated lairs.

Organized and methodical, with an insatiable curiosity and eidetic memory, sage dragons are the devout researchers of the dragon world. The intellectual pursuits of sage dragons demand extended periods of quiet study, one of the reasons that such dragons live in isolated, hidden locations. Young dragons tend to specialize in a particular area of research. As they age, these research interests also broaden, with an experto in a particular river expanding into topics such as the water cycle, ecology, or the Plane of Water. Sage dragons interested in religious topics often worship Nethys or a god dedicated to knowledge, such as Gruhastha, Qi Zhong, or Ydajisk. Dragons who seek grim rituals or cryptic knowledge might join the church of Abraxas or worship Norgorber in his aspect of the Reaper of Reputation.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Spell.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Spells

action->Divert Essence.name: Divert Essence
action->Divert Essence.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 90 pies Casts a Spell that targets the dragon

Efecto The sage dragon steals energy from the conjuro to protect itself, gaining resistance to daño from conjuros equal to the triggering conjuro's rank until the beginning of their next turn.

action->Eldritch Interference.name: Eldritch Interference
action->Eldritch Interference.description:
90 pies, @Check[will|dc:40].

Overlapping fields near the dragon make spellcasting unpredictable. A criatura that enters or begins its turn in the area must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result of the tirada de salvación, the criatura is temporarily immune to this dragon's eldritch interference for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico For 1 asalto, when the criatura Casts a Spell that either deals daño or restores Puntos de Golpe, they gain a bonificador de estado to the conjuro's daño or healing equal to the conjuro's rank.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected.

Fallo For 1 asalto, when the criatura Casts a Spell that either deals daño or restores Puntos de Golpe, they take a penalización de estado to the conjuro's daño or healing equal to the conjuro's rank.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the effect lasts 1 minuto.

action->Draconic Frenzy.name: Frenesí Dracónico
action->Draconic Frenzy.description: El dragón realiza dos Golpes de garra y un Golpe de cola en cualquier orden.

action->Draconic Momentum.name: Impulso dracónico
action->Draconic Momentum.description: El dragón recarga Overwhelming Proclamation siempre que consigue un impacto crítico con un Golpe.

action->Endless Spellscales.name: Endless Spellscales
action->Endless Spellscales.description:
1 to 3

The dragon expends a conjuro inscribed on one of their scales, casting a common conjuro of 7th rank or lower from any tradition, using the conjuro's typical number of actions and their conjuro DC.

action->Mystic Facility.name: Mystic Facility
action->Mystic Facility.description: The dragon can activate scrolls and wands of any tradition as if the conjuros they contain were occult conjuros.

action->Overwhelming Proclamation.name: Overwhelming Proclamation
action->Overwhelming Proclamation.description: The dragon exclaims hidden truths that only they have been able to understand, dealing @Damage[22d6[mental]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[will|dc:44|basic] salvación). On a critical failure, criaturas are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. The dragon can't use Overwhelming Proclamation again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Overwhelming Proclamation]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Reflexive Understanding.name: Reflexive Understanding
action->Reflexive Understanding.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Requisitos The dragon was targeted by a conjuro of 9th rank or lower in the last round

Efecto The dragon analyzes the conjuro's inner workings. For the next 10 minutos, the dragon can cast the conjuro at the same rank as if it were one of their innate occult conjuros.

action->Reveal Shame.name: Reveal Shame
action->Reveal Shame.description:
Requisitos The dragon has successfully Recalled Knowledge about an enemigo within 90 pies

Efecto The dragon utters an embarrassing secret about the criatura, unnerving them and their allies. Every enemigo within 90 pies that can hear the secret must attempt a @Check[will|dc:44] salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}. Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 asalto and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 3}. Sanguine Knowledge As young sage dragon.

action->Sanguine Knowledge.name: Sanguine Knowledge
action->Sanguine Knowledge.description: The first time each encounter a dragon hits and deals daño to a criatura with their jaws Golpe, they receive information about the criatura as if the dragon had succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that criatura.

A shining, rune-inscribed scale is all that most people, even adventurers, see of a sage dragon during their lifetimes. Even then, only those familiar with dragon LORE will likely recognize the scale as anything other than an elaborate conjuro scroll. Collectors and scholars of esoteric LORE, sage dragons become increasingly reclusive as they age, and, even in their youths, they're prone to work through trusted intermediaries. For those able to locate and gain the trust of such a criatura, even the youngest sage dragons are fonts of difficult-to-find knowledge and rare magical techniques. The oldest sage dragons are living combinations of gargantuan libraries and endless grimoires, accumulating the secrets of the Universe, and beyond, in their isolated lairs.

Organized and methodical, with an insatiable curiosity and eidetic memory, sage dragons are the devout researchers of the dragon world. The intellectual pursuits of sage dragons demand extended periods of quiet study, one of the reasons that such dragons live in isolated, hidden locations. Young dragons tend to specialize in a particular area of research. As they age, these research interests also broaden, with an experto in a particular river expanding into topics such as the water cycle, ecology, or the Plane of Water. Sage dragons interested in religious topics often worship Nethys or a god dedicated to knowledge, such as Gruhastha, Qi Zhong, or Ydajisk. Dragons who seek grim rituals or cryptic knowledge might join the church of Abraxas or worship Norgorber in his aspect of the Reaper of Reputation.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Spell.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Spells

action->Divert Essence.name: Divert Essence
action->Divert Essence.description:
Desencadenante A criatura within 90 pies Casts a Spell that targets the dragon

Efecto The sage dragon steals energy from the conjuro to protect itself, gaining resistance to daño from conjuros equal to the triggering conjuro's rank until the beginning of their next turn.

action->Eldritch Interference.name: Eldritch Interference
action->Eldritch Interference.description:
90 pies, @Check[will|dc:25].

Overlapping fields near the dragon make spellcasting unpredictable. A criatura that enters or begins its turn in the area must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result of the tirada de salvación, the criatura is temporarily immune to this dragon's eldritch interference for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico For 1 asalto, when the criatura Casts a Spell that either deals daño or restores Puntos de Golpe, they gain a bonificador de estado to the conjuro's daño or healing equal to the conjuro's rank.

Éxito The criatura is unaffected.

Fallo For 1 asalto, when the criatura Casts a Spell that either deals daño or restores Puntos de Golpe, they take a penalización de estado to the conjuro's daño or healing equal to the conjuro's rank.

Fallo crítico As failure, but the effect lasts 1 minuto.

action->Mystic Facility.name: Mystic Facility
action->Mystic Facility.description: The dragon can activate scrolls and wands of any tradition as if the conjuros they contain were occult conjuros.

action->Overwhelming Proclamation.name: Overwhelming Proclamation
action->Overwhelming Proclamation.description: The dragon exclaims hidden truths that only they have been able to understand, dealing @Damage[10d6[mental]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] (@Check[will|dc:28|basic] salvación). On a critical failure, criaturas are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. The dragon can't use Overwhelming Proclamation again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Overwhelming Proclamation]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Sanguine Knowledge.name: Sanguine Knowledge
action->Sanguine Knowledge.description: The first time each encounter a dragon hits and deals daño to a criatura with their jaws Golpe, they receive information about the criatura as if the dragon had succeeded at a check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about that criatura.

Sarkorian Wolf.name: Lobo sarkoriano
Sarkorian Wolf.publicNotes:
To survive vivo en el Worldwound, Sarkorian wolves developed defenses against el Abyss. They've quedan symbols for Mendevian crusaders who struggled a adapt a el world after el war ended.

Wolves roam bosques, hills, y otro wild lands, where ellos hunt en packs a beleaguer y surround su prey before going en for el kill. Like most predatory animals, wolves prefer a ataque el weakest o most vulnerable prey ellos puede find.

action->Pack Attack.name: Ataque en manada
action->Pack Attack.description: The wolf's Golpes deal 1d4 daño adicional to criaturas within reach of at least two of the wolf's allies.

Sea Archdragon.name: Sea Archdragon
Sea Archdragon.publicNotes:
Imperial sea dragones son associated con elemental agua y oversee rain, storms, rivers, y oceans. They live adjacent a el civilizations de Tian Xia, ready a aid mortal affairs y prove su worth. For some sea dragones, providing assistance en matters de el weather y arcano knowledge es un duty. For others, ello's un perk que leads a valuable tributes o delicious meals. Visiting petitioners son todos too eager a provide, for ello's said que cuando un sea dragon es pleased, el rain es gentle y plentiful. In contrast, cuando ellos're angered, el storm spares none de su fury.

Despite common Tian belief, civilization hardly lives at el mercy de el sea dragones, for most son subjects de kingdoms sworn a assist mortals. Most sea dragones son subjects de one de el four sea dragon kings, whose nation o united territories son based out en el Embaral Ocean, Ivory Sea, Okaiyo Ocean, y Songil Sea. Given el lack de native sea dragones en el Plane de agua, ello's theorized que these kingdoms might be remnants de un mass exodus de el Boundless Sea. El sea dragon's own myths say su kings de viejo took oaths a escapar persecution de el Elemental Lord Kelizandri. Mientras ello's uncertain si el Brackish Emperor yet seeks a exterminate el sea dragones, most uphold el sworn promise as part de su cultural heritage o en honor de su forebears.
Sea Archdragon.saveDetails: +1 de estado a todas las salvaciones contra magia

If either Golpe hits, the dragon can attempt to GRAB el objetivo with that limb as a free action. The dragon can have up to three criaturas @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} at a time; one in each of its front claws, and a third with their tail.

action->Tidal Wave.name: Maremoto
action->Tidal Wave.description:
Frecuencia once per 10 minutos

Efecto The dragon slams their body down, sending a towering wave outward. Este wave deals @Damage[11d12[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] daño in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:90]. Each criatura in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:42] salvación. Structures and unattended objects in the area take full daño with no tirada de salvación.

Éxito crítico The criatura takes no daño but is pushed 30 pies from the dragon.

Éxito The criatura takes half daño and is pushed 60 pies from the dragon.

Fallo The criatura takes full daño, is pushed 120 pies from the dragon, and falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Fallo crítico As failure, but double daño.

action->Typhoon Fling.name: Typhoon Fling
action->Typhoon Fling.description:
Frecuencia una vez por hora

Efecto The dragon Flies up to half its Fly speed. All criaturas the dragon passes within 10 pies of must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] salvación or be blown 120 pies up in the air and then fall, taking fall daño as appropriate. Las criaturas already airborne add their current height to the distance fallen.

Shackles Pirate Crew.name: Shackles Pirate Crew
Shackles Pirate Crew.publicNotes: El fleets de ships sent by el Free Captains de el Shackles tienen proven invaluable a Andoran's efforts a romper el Hespereth blockade, todos mientras acting as un consistent thorn en el side de Cheliax by conducting regular raids a plunder su settlements along el southern coast. Pirate crews va a sometimes get rowdy cuando su ship docks y start drunken bar brawls.

action->Disarming Twist.name: Giro desarmante
action->Disarming Twist.description:
Requisitos The crew's previous action was a Scurvy Golpe that dealt daño to at least one enemigo

Efecto The crew uses their armas to knock the armas out of their enemies' hands. The crew attempts a single ATHLETICS check to [[/act disarm]], comparing the result to the Reflex DC of each criatura that was damaged by the required Scurvy Golpe. If the result is a critical failure, the crew gets a failure instead.

action->Scurvy Strike.name: Scurvy Golpe
action->Scurvy Strike.description:
1 to 3

Frecuencia una vez por asalto

Efecto The crew strikes with belaying pins, hooks, and cutlasses at enemies in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] salvación). The daño depends on the number of actions.

1 @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]]{1d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or daño cortante}

2 @Damage[(2d6+4)[bludgeoning]]{2d6+4 bludgeoning, piercing, or daño cortante}

3 @Damage[(3d6+6)[bludgeoning]]{3d6+6 bludgeoning, piercing, or daño cortante}

Shroudwing.name: Shroudwing
Shroudwing.publicNotes:
Estos unsettling birds are thick-bodied, long-legged criaturas standing 4 to 5 pies tall with an 8-pies wingspan. They possess black feathers, clouded white eyes, and a menacing obsidian bill hooked at the tip like a curled claw. Sometimes called soul-eater crows, shroudwings are carrion feeders known to roam graveyards and sites of collective death, absorbing lingering spirits and consuming the decaying corpses. They can be found digging up grave sites, shoveling the earth and breaking into caskets or tombs with their massive, hooked beaks, as well as lurking at execution sites, burial mounds, or feeding on travelers' corpses left behind on roadsides.

Due to their size, shape, and propensity for burial grounds, it isn't uncommon for a shroudwing to be mistaken for a grieving widow when seen at a distance—only when an unfortunate criatura gets close enough does it discover the danger it's in. Though not predatory or outright aggressive, shroudwings are exceptionally territorial; they'll protect and defend both their feeding site as well as their nesting area from anyone who might trespass upon it.

While many might know these unusual birds by name and sight, even more know the shroudwing by sound. When threatened, the shroudwing emits a haunting, fear-inducing death rattle that can be heard for miles. They prefer nesting in covered brush, and their mating season occurs in the winter months. Shroudwings have a particular fondness for the collection of skulls and have been known to decorate nests with them as well as to use them in mating rituals, with the male presenting the female with the freshest and cleanest skull it can find.

action->Death Rattle.name: Estertor de muerte
action->Death Rattle.description:
The shroudwing emits a guttural, haunting call that instills a sense of fear almost impossible to shake. Each non-shroudwing criatura within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] salvación. Regardless of the result, criaturas are then temporarily immune to Death Rattle for 1 minuto.

Éxito crítico The criatura is unaffected.

Éxito The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the start of the shroudwing's next turn.

Fallo The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 1}.

Fallo crítico The criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustado 2}.

action->Grave Blight.name: Grave Blight
action->Grave Blight.description:
Tirada de salvación @Check[fortitude|dc:18]

Etapa 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 día)

Etapa 2 @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] daño every hour, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and can't reduce the value of the sickened condition while taking daño persistente de veneno (1 día)

Etapa 3 @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]] daño every hour, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}, and can't reduce the value of the sickened condition while taking daño persistente de veneno (1 día)

action->Soul Feeding.name: Soul Feeding
action->Soul Feeding.description:
Requisitos The shroudwing is adjacent to a dying criatura

Efecto The shroudwing attempts to devour the dying criatura's soul. The criatura must attempt a @Check[will|dc:18] salvación or their dying condition increases by 1 and the shroudwing regains @Damage[2d8[healing]] Puntos de Golpe.

Shui Gui.name: Shui Gui
Shui Gui.publicNotes:
Cuando un person drowns en un cuerpo de agua, there's un chance que su espiritual va a be trapped y unable a reincarnate. Twisted con anger, spite, y malice, el espiritual transforms into un shui gui.

Si someone sees un shui gui de shore, ellos'll often see solo el top part de un cabeza con two pinprick reflections de light de su eyes. Lurking under docks y near el agua's edge, el shui gui calls out a people o makes disturbances a draw them dentro de reach de el agua. Once el unsuspecting victim es close enough, el espiritual pulls them underwater, drowns them, y possesses su cuerpo en un process known as ti sh-en. Once el espiritual successfully inhabits el vacant cuerpo, ellos escapar su curse y live un nuevo life; however, su victim's espiritual remains trapped en el agua until, at last, ellos too drown un hapless passerby, thus continuing un never-ending cycle.

Un shui gui es terrified de fuego, y those who camp by agua o travel by boat son advised a always keep un lantern handy. Charms y amulets puede also keep el shui gui at bay, but el espiritual es generally weakest after being goaded onto land.

action->Water-Bound Curse.name: Water-Bound Curse
action->Water-Bound Curse.description: The shui gui is bound to the body of water in which it died. It's unable to move further than 120 pies from the edge of the water.

action->Rejuvenation.name:
<Compendium> la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.unR8VVR4yyRnsmnB]
Rejuvenecimiento
action->Rejuvenation.description:
la etiqueta se reemplazará con el texto de la entrada del compendio @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-family-ability-glossary.Item.unR8VVR4yyRnsmnB]

When the shui gui is destroyed, it reforms after [[/br 2d4 #days]]{2d4 days} within the body of water it's bound to, fully healing. It can be permanently destroyed if the body of the shui gui who originally died in the water can be found and laid to rest.

action->Ti Shõn.name: Ti Shõn
action->Ti Shõn.description:
Desencadenante A criatura @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the shui gui dies of suffocation

Efecto Ripping the spirit of its drowned victim out of el objetivo's body, the shui gui enters the corpse to take the original owner's place. The shui gui then returns to life at the edge of its body of water as if it had been el objetivo of a successful resurrect ritual, except it has the appearance of el objetivo rather than its original body. After a week, the spirit of the drowned criatura becomes a shui gui. The new spirit can't be raised from the dead by normal magical means until they've been destroyed as a shui gui.

action->Drag Under.name: Drag Under
action->Drag Under.description: The shui gui Swims at half Velocidad, along with any criatura it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

action->Drown the Living.name: Drown the Living
action->Drown the Living.description:
Requisitos El objetivo must be holding its breath and be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the shui gui
